The method requires limited changes in function and almost no changes in interfaces. With this method, P-CSCF could be provided to terminal more intelligent, also the registration could be smoother.

articleTitle: Study on early warning of gas in coal mine based on extension data mining
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The gas disaster is threatening the safety of China's coal mines“ the number one killer.” Comprehensive and systematic understanding of a variety of leading gas accidents reasons and early scientific warning of gas for work safety in coal mines is an urgent need to address the problem. Predictions of coal gas for the problems, this paper use the extension data mining technology and it not only from a lot of information to mining useful knowledge, but also to identify potential hidden information. This can help us make the right decisions and improve the high coal gas disaster early-warning rate. This paper describes the extension data mining theory, with the extension data mining solution to coal mine disasters in the steps and using examples to prove the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Quality analysis of Pseudorandom Number Generator using rough sets
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This In this paper, a rough sets based analyzing system for Pseudorandom Number Generator (PRNG) is proposed to analyze the quality of the pseudorandom number generators. The strength of the cryptosystem relied on the quality of PRNGs. In particular, their outputs must be unpredictable in the absence of knowledge of the inputs and the input can not be guessed. On the other hand, the advance in computer science and technology let to produce the sufficient amount of sequence numbers of all possible input (seeds) and can be stored in a database. By means of the rough set approach, the input (seeds) can be guessed from those databases, using the known output sequence. So, the quality analysis of the (PRNGs) and a simple rule based prediction system is presented in this paper and the design of generators is outside the scope of this paper.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Academy-Oriented Resource Planning
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Raffle of mobile phones to Pay by purchasing effects in the new media service application
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The new media technology platform to pay by purchasing effects based on the internet, Mobile Phones is not to abandon the traditional advertising this purpose the same time, an increase of Pay-for-project, and the combination of mobile phone platforms, networking platforms and existing sales channels, to fully enable businesses to interact with consumers shopping, and will translate into a price war on the buying behavior of consumers real benefits. This article take the real estate interaction marketing as an example, discussed Raffle of mobile phones to Pay by purchasing Effects in the new media service application.

articleTitle: Applying LS-DYNA to construct virtual experiment system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In the field of teaching, virtual experiment is increasingly becoming an important supplement to the real experiment, and it has been successfully used in many of the teaching curriculum. The finite element software LS-DYNA is applied in the field of Virtual experiments. Virtual experiment system of “terminal effects” is constructed by using VC and LS-DYNA. The system is based on the campus network, divided into the server software and the client software. The serer used the high performance computation server, and core function of its software is modifying the K file and calling the LS-DYNA software to compute. This system is convenient for undergraduate student to grasp “terminal effects”.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Student evaluation through Student Idol
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Visual Semantic Client a visualization tool for semantic content
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The University of Applied Sciences Technikum Wien is a fast-growing education organization that actually offers a set of 12 bachelor and 14 master degree programs. Coordination of lectures and therefore quality management has become more and more difficult. Knowledge management in terms of lecture contents and professional skills of lecturers seems to be an unsolvable task. As a matter of fact, nobody is able to overlook all teaching details of the whole university. Although information is available in several databases and documents even getting an overview of all detail content of a single degree program turns out to be impossible. To overcome this problem the Technikum Wien started a project to extract selected information from documents and store it in a Semantic Wiki by automatically setting up entities and their relations. To improve usage of semantic content a software tool to browse the information categories and their relations has being developed. The “Visual Semantic Client” visualizes entities with their attributes and allows following or searching their relations. The paper shows the concepts behind, the system architecture and the current state of development.

articleTitle: Adaptive Frequency sweep analysis for electromagnetic problems using the Thiele interpolating continued fractions
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: A direct rational approximation method based on Thiele interpolating continued fractions theory is proposed for fast frequency sweep analysis of electromagnetic problems. And an adaptive algorithm is also formed. Compared with the conventional rational approximation method, the proposed method can get a rational approximation directly without a great number of matrix inverse computations and doesn't need to allocate much memory for high derivatives of the dense impedance matrix. Meanwhile, the computation of surface currents by continued fractions can be sped up as compared with the traditional rational approximation. Numerical simulations for broad band scattering analysis of different shaped objects are discussed to shown the effectiveness of the present method.

articleTitle: The principles of multimedia teaching design based on cognitive load theory
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper systematically describes the cognitive load theory, and puts forward the general principles of the design of multimedia courseware based on the study of a large number of literatures and the foundings of the questionnaire of the effective application of multimedia teaching in X University, so as to improve efficiency of the application of multimedia teaching.

articleTitle: Realization of RRO-NRDPWT-based ECG signal compression with modified run-length coding
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: With high compression performance, realization of wavelet-based data compression system is significant for multi-lead ECG signal recording. In this paper, we proposed a modified run-length coding (MRLC) algorithm associated with an efficient quantization scheme for the realization of a RRO-NRDPWT-based ECG data compression system. The MRLC has the characteristics of regularity and low computational complexity which make it a suitable for hardware implementation at a cost of compression performance. This compromise will be compensated by the new quantization scheme. By using the MIT-BIH arrhythmia database, the experimental results show that the proposed scheme can be competitive comparing to other wavelet-based approaches in compression performance. In addition, the MRLC can improve traditional run-length coding by about 13%.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Good governance in Jammu & Kashmir - Strategic intersections
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The thinking ground of educational innovation and fostering of creative talents-illustrated by the case of classification of enterprise organizational structure
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The key of educational innovation and fostering of creative talents lies in training the independent thinking ability of students. Carrying out the course on “formal logics” is an effective means in improving the rational thinking ability. From the errors of relevant management works in classifying enterprise organizational structure, this paper presents the prerequisite for classification and the logical pattern for classifying. Aiming at enterprise organizational structure, this paper presents three appropriate classification standards and corresponding results. This paper refers that the set up of “formal logics” course should be an urgent demand for educational innovation and fostering of creative talents, thus fostering the idea of free thinking and independent spirits.

articleTitle: Architectural plan for constructing fault tolerable workflow engines based on grid service
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: in this paper the design and implementation of fault tolerable architecture for scientific workflow engines is presented. The engines are assumed to be implemented as composite web services. Current architectures for workflow engines do not make any considerations for substituting faulty web services with correct ones at run time. The difficulty is to rollback the execution state of the workflow engine to its state before the invocation of the faulty web service. To achieve this, three components for fault diagnosis, recording the execution state of the workflow and substitution of faulty web services, at run time, are considered in our proposed architecture. The applicability of the proposed architecture is practically evaluated by applying it to design three different scientific workflow engines.

articleTitle: A certificateless threshold signature scheme without parings in P2P networks
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In P2P networks, a valid signature scheme plays an important role in identification of users, authenticity and integrity of sharing information. In this paper, we propose an efficient and secure threshold signature scheme without parings and a trusted party based on CL-PKC, which fits the characteristics of P2P networks. By introducing threshold secret sharing, our scheme without a trusted party solves the risks of single-point failure caused by almost signature schemes. Moreover, our scheme is more computationally efficient than other schemes built from pairings. So the new scheme is of great practical and efficiency for P2P networks.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of file-splitting algorithm in peer-to-peer network backup systems
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: We propose a performance model for a peer-to-peer network backup systems. Our model provides a framework for evaluating backup time and file availability of the backup systems. In our study, files are splitting in three different modes: one chunk per node, fixed block size, and erasure code (Reed-Solomon and Luby Transform in particular). The results show that increasing the number of peers does not always increasing file availability. To get an optimal backup time (with best file availability), we discuss guidelines for parameter selections. Our models are validated by varying configurations and testing in a controlled environment.

articleTitle: Experiences and methods of feedback research in human-computer interaction
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Feedback is the language of human-computer interaction. This article summarizes 6 type feedbacks systematically through a large number of phenomena and shows the basis and reasons of systematicness. Characteristics and limitation of feedbacks form different results of experience. The effective experience of feedback must follow 3 design principles and develop along the trend of future.

articleTitle: Effectively cultivating undergraduate computer application ability of management department
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper presentes some courses and pedagogical methods to effectively cultivate undergraduates' computer abilities. It describes a computer curricular framework, which emphasizes the theoretical and practical aspects of information technology application development. The courses divide into two threads in accordance with the basic skills and professional skills. The former is that all students master knowledge. The latter is professional skills training according to speciality. The paper also introduced several effective pedagogical methods in order to increase practice ability, self-study ability and innovation ability of students. Experimentation is an important ability cultivating means, which train students a high level of computer application ability. So this paper introduces experimentation arrangement. A formal evaluation has been carried out and demonstrated a very effective and realistic learning experience for the students.

articleTitle: The application of project management in project-driven teaching model
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Project-driven teaching model is a special teaching model in Jiangxi Normal University. Though the model has been a great success, there are still some problems. This paper puts forward that project management technology is applied to project-driven teaching model through tutorial system. It means the use of mature engineering technologies and methods in teaching management. Regarding teaching activities as engineering project not only represents an useful exploration for teaching management model, but also plays a very active role in improving our teaching management. The study and practice of this research proves that the application of project management methods in teaching can serve the purpose of improving teaching effectiveness.

articleTitle: An elastic - Fluid mixing Web layout design based on css
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: As the diversity and differences of Web browser and browsing habits, that many Web client effect is inconsistent with the Web designer's design objective of the layout. Even it affected the readability and the overall layout aesthetics of the Web. By combining the use of multiple layout techniques, the design has made the improvement in view of the present popular CSS Web Layout mode, and provided the practical Elastic - Fluid mixing web Layout pattern.

articleTitle: Detecting appropriate replication approach considering client and server parameters in mobile environment
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Mobile technology is going to be one of the most useful and practical technologies over 21 century. Mobile devices with integrated databases or caches are so useful for most of applications. This new environment with mobile servers and clients has some special characteristics that vary it from traditional distributed systems. Because of these special properties, protocols which were designed for traditional systems are not suitable for mobile environments. Previous schemes are passive in nature and rarely consider these new characteristics. One of the most important and useful schemes especially in distributed databases is replication. Replication techniques are used to increase performance, availability, reliability and scalability of various types of distributed systems (e.g. p2p and data grid). But obviously they are not appropriate for this new environment with unique characteristics and dynamic features. It is better to design situation depended protocols with dynamic nature. In this paper we illustrate part of a framework that can mange replication strategy in various situations. For this mean values of most important properties for basic components of environment (e.g. mobile servers and clients) will be used to choose an appropriate strategy through multi criteria decision making approach.

articleTitle: The realization of report in Sewage Treatment system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Expounding the realization of two reports functions of automatic and manual in the application of INTELLUTION IFIX monitoring software by the establishment of dispatching events and the proceduring script in the controlling system of No.2 Sewage Treatment Plant in Changchun.

articleTitle: The construction of virtual learning community of intelligence based on entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper provides a method of construction of learning community of intelligence based on analysis of entropy theory. We analyze browse informations of learners based on entropy theory,and building the same kind of learning by interests,building the best adaptive model based on maximum entropy principle, building up evaluation system of learners participation based on entropy theory. We have attempted to establish scheme of mathematical model. We wished to obtain first - hand information by practice research, and teaching students how to learn and imparting them effective learning strategies.

articleTitle: Analysis of individual factors in the established group E-learning
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Established group E-learning is a pattern used frequently in E-learning, and individual factors play an important role in this pattern. People can analyses the influence following many aspects of teacher, tutor and students. Such as appropriate authority of the teacher's through the study, teacher's capacity of evaluation and organizing and supporting learning in the network, tutor's model function and communicative competence On-line, students' questioning of E-learning, self-monitoring ability, approval of appraisal mechanism, following the crowd psychology in E-learning. At last, people can find some effective measure to improve the function of E-learning.

articleTitle: Research on efficacy of practical teaching content in two-dimensional animation course
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The methods of running a school of higher vocational and technical colleges decide practical teaching's subject position, the key of perfecting the practical teaching system is scientific and systematic practical teaching contents. This thesis mainly explores the practical teaching contents of two-dimensional animation course from three affects which are the research on effectiveness of professional ability in two-dimensional animation course, analysis of the effectiveness of the work task, the efficacy description of learning field.

articleTitle: An augment algorithm based on sufficient formal context
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Formal Concept Analysis(FCA) is one of the powerful tools for cognitive science. A concept lattice induced by a context is the core data structure of FCA. A formal context expresses the incidence relation between objects and attributes. It is obvious that the constraint relation between attributes exists. An attribute hierarchy constituted by the attribute relation inevitably restricts the formation of context. Based on an attribute hierarchy, studying the property of the attribute hierarchy, sufficient formal context is defined, the augment algorithm of generating sufficient context is given, and its performance is shown.

articleTitle: Bi-direction branch and bound method to solve the single machine total weighted completion time problem with job release times
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper considers the problem of scheduling n jobs on a single machine to minimize the total weighted completion time. Each job has a release time, a processing time and a weight. For the problem, we present a bi-direction branching scheme based on branch and bound method, called bi-direction branch and bound (BDBAD), which incorporates forward-driven and backward-driven schemes and emphasizes the use of bi-direction branching in determining lower bounds. We offered an example to illustrate the BDBAD method, and compare it with the ILOG OPL version 3.7 which is a well-known optimization tool to obtain optimal solutions. The results showed that the proposed BDBAD method can significantly reduce the total number of branching nodes compared with the nodes branched by ILOG OPL.

articleTitle: Construction and application of autonomous learning based remote downhole tool virtual lab
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The traditional downhole tool experimental teaching has problems of poor teaching results, poor learner autonomy, not conducive for oilfield staff to carry out continuing education, etc. Virtual laboratory and remote education were combined to build a new experimental teaching model, which provides an effective solution to above problems, achieving the purposes of autonomous learning of students in school and remote training of oilfield staff. The key technologies in developing remote downhole tool virtual lab were described in detail from the aspects of network structure, experimental contents, interface and interaction design, and realization and release. Practical application showed that the virtual lab played an important role in experimental teaching and achieved good effects.

articleTitle: Improvements of one anonymous ID-based encryption
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In 2006, Boyen et al proposed an anonymous ID-based encryption. It is impressive in the scheme the system secret key is a tuple of five numbers. The user's secret key is also a tuple of five elements. The authors did not explain why it should introduce so many parameters. In this paper, we simulate a general attempt to attack the scheme. It shows us which parameters are essential to the scheme and which parameters can be reasonably discarded. Based on the analysis we present a simplified version and an efficient version of the original scheme. The general techniques developed in this paper will be helpful to better other cryptographic protocols.

articleTitle: Comparative research on Hong Kong Domain name dispute resolution system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: To elucidate the deficiency in Hong Kong domain name dispute resolution mechanism, this article starts from the comparative study of Domain name dispute resolution system, analyze the procedural mechanism and reverse domain name hijacking policy in Hong Kong. The resulted showed that the mandatory arbitration proceeding in Hong Kong is in favor of mark holder, Also, the rules of HKDNR can not effectively penalize reverse domain name hijacking, the interests of the domain name registrants, therefore, have been ignored.

articleTitle: A trusted computing approach to building trusted connect between entities in mobile agents environment
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Mobile agents can provide many benefits to the development of distributed applications. But the mobile agent system will face some security threat since it will run in an opening network environment. In this paper, we analyzed the security threats in mobile agent system and provided a method to build the trusted connect between entities in mobile agent environment. This method uses the trusted platform module in trusted computing platform as the trusted base. When a mobile agent wants to migrate to another platform, it should use a trusted connect between the source host and the goal host. The agent and agent platform can trust with each other. This method will be helpful to build a trusted computing environment for the mobile agent system.

articleTitle: Study on key technology of large-scale terrain walkthrough system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: For massive terrain DEM data and texture data, the key technology of large-scale terrain walkthrough system are designing reasonable scene data storage and effective dynamical schedule strategy, which is summarized and discussed in this paper. The author has realized the display smoothness and continuity of the large-scale scene walkthrough system through block storage of the terrain and texture data, dynamic scheduling strategy, and introducing multi-threading technology to realize parallelization of rendering threads and data scheduling threads.

articleTitle: The study of Anchored Instruction's application based on Web3D
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Anchored Instruction is one of the main forms of online teaching, but lots of problems exist in Anchored Instruction based on network widely, such as the lack of participa, attributive and so on. The application of Web3D technology, which can create a vivid image of interesting information for students in realistic environment, not only stimulates students' interest in learning and internal motivation, but also enhances learners' participation and a sense of belonging, making up for the current Web-based Anchored Instruction inadequate. According to the previous research, we analyzed and described the insufficiency of teaching experience under Web2.0. Then, the paper explained Anchored Teaching's concept, characteristics and the lack of applications currently. At last, through a Web3D-based Anchored Instruction teaching case, the paper demonstrated some of the characteristics which Anchored Instruction has, hoping to improve the efficiency of Anchored Teaching.

articleTitle: Relation between language and culture in English teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The relation between language and culture in English teaching activities has been presented in this paper, indicating that language is the carrier of culture, language and culture promote and influence one another, and culture contains intrinsic rules or conventions directing language use. The specific involvement of culture in English study has also been discussed in different cases. The language features of cultural introduction have been described in detail indicating that the culture introduction in English study and teaching is challenge to English teachers with broad contents.

articleTitle: Text compression using ambigrams
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The networking field is looking forward to improved and efficient methods in channel utilization. For some text, data recovery becomes indispensable because of the importance of data it holds. Therefore, a lossless decomposition algorithm which is independent of the nature and pattern of text is today's top concern. Efficiency of algorithms used today varies greatly depending on the nature of text. Such algorithms need some characters to be frequently appearing in the text and randomness in the characters present distorts the consistency to a large extent. This paper brings in the idea of using an art form called ambigram to compress text with consistency in the efficiency of the compression.

articleTitle: Practice platform for program design algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Program is soul of the computer, while algorithm is kernel of the program. This paper discusses the guiding ideology of teaching program design, emphasizes the importance of improving students' debugging capabilities. In order to cope with varying education levels caused by domestic regional economic disparities, the authors proposed opening a new course “The Computer Algorithm and Practice” as the threshold to the computer beginners and have developed a practice platform with a simple syntax, simple debugging environment. This platform provides students with an intuitive and effective auxiliary. After three years of teaching practice, it is verified that the course and the platform lay a solid foundation for follow-up computing courses.

articleTitle: Using sequence number compensation to design DCCP partial reliability extension
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Datagram Congestion Control Protocol (DCCP), possessing congestion control and unreliable transmission, specially suits real-time multimedia applications. Nevertheless, losses of key packets will cause a substantial decline on quality of services (QoS) in some applications. This paper proposes a DCCP partial reliability extension (PR-DCCP) that can retransmit lost packets as needed. Since DCCP uses an incremental sequence number, the retransmitted packets cannot utilize their original sequence number. To solve this problem, PR-DCCP adopts sequence number compensation, which appends an offset to the retransmitted packet; thus the receiver can use the sequence number of this retransmitted packet and the attached offset so as to re-obtain the original sequence number. The simulation uses two performance metrics: Decodable Frame Ratio (DFR) representing QoS, and Useless Data Received Ratio (UDRR) representing the bandwidth waste. These are used to evaluate different transport protocols, namely, PR-DCCP, DCCP, SCTP, TCP, and UDP. Simulation results show that PR-DCCP has the better DFR and UDRR than other transport protocols in almost all cases. For various movies, a DFR of PR-DCCP is 1.2% – 12.4% higher than that of DCCP; while UDRR is lower by 73.2% – 85.1%. Furthermore, the reliability policies to determine which packets require reliability are investigated.

articleTitle: Design of a Register Update Unit and a branch prediction unit of a microprocessor based on superscalar architecture using VLSI
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In the field of microprocessors, speeds of processors doubles in every 18 months as, new microprocessors are always being designed using more and more advanced features. So, it's always a challenge to design a new microprocessor with faster execution speed. This paper discusses about design of microarchitecture of superscalar processor using VLSI. This Proposed design is based on the rigorous research done through simulation of superscalar architecture using Simplescalar tool. The research was concentrated in three areas 1. Data dependence 2. Control dependence 3. Memory latency Various results were taken for several benchmarks in areas of operating system, database, and mathematics etc using `C' language for different combinations of parameters. An optimum model was developed which would give a consistent performance in all the above areas. Among the three areas we are concentrating on the design of a Register Update Unit of Data dependence area and 1-level, 2-level branch prediction schemes of control dependence area. The units will be externally interfaced to an IP core through VLSI technique. By verifying the performance of the RUU and branch prediction unit using FPGA we are trying to find out an optimum unit for superscalar processor.

articleTitle: Online learning community for mathematics teachers in Singapore: Online facilitation
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This article aims at building the knowledge base for onling learning community through examining the trends of and challenges in building online learning community for mathematics teachers and the role of e-facilitation. We reviewed related research with a particular focus on ERIC database and built a taxonomy of topics. The follwing results are highlighted: effective strategies for promoting online discussion include constructing subject knowledge, designing video cases with prompts and inclusion of case teacher for online discussions as well as the role of facilitation in overcoming challenges in online discussion. A strategic framework for promoting online learning community is also discussed.

articleTitle: Highway passenger traffic volume correlation analysis based on gray relational grade
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Grey relational analysis is based on similar degree of the the time series curve to determine the correlation between factors.In this paper, we use the gray relational analysis method to study the city's GDP, the average consumption level, the city population, passenger vehicle amount of these related factors affecting the road passenger traffic, and linear regression analysis in SPSS verifies the results. Examples show that grey relational analysis method is reliable and accurate for analysis of the road passenger traffic and has better usability.

articleTitle: Emergence of collective intelligence in distance education system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: With the rapid advancement of computer multimedia technology and network technology, distance education becomes an open complex giant system including users, educational resources, technology support system, network environment, and online media. Distance education system meta-synthesizes human intelligence, high capability of computer, the intercourse platform of knowledge creativity and organizational creativity. It is a challenging task to adopt new theory, methodology and computational tools to solve problems of complex distance education. Therefore, based on the complexity science and metasynthesis methodology, the emergence of collective intelligence in distance education system is studied by the inter-response embodied in the contents of interactions among users. Algorithm tools, i.e. link structure and attributed directed graph have been developed to distill the emergence of collective wisdom on some topic.

articleTitle: 3D Covalent Bonding Molecular Structure Stimulating Program using the VSEPR theory for undergraduate students
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Current knowledge delivery in education is dynamically changing to more flexible and reliable. Researchers attempt to alternatively present new ways of learning. Computer-Aided Instruction (CAI) programs have been introduced in many fields. The 3D Covalent Bonding Molecular Structure Stimulating Program is one of the CAI programs in studying basic molecular structures for undergraduate students. Open source software packages are selected to construct the program in order to support the boundless delivery of knowledge. It simulates most of the covalent bonding molecular structures with dynamic inputs. Experimental tests have been performed to confirm students' satisfactory. The experimental tests included 46 undergraduate students and the overall satisfactory result of 82.70%.

articleTitle: Exploring innovative strategies for managing urban communities
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Traditional means of urban community management are not satisfying the new demands placed by a modern city. Gridding Urban Management (GUM) seems to be a promising model for urban management in the 21st century. But the GUM is immature due to the lack of innovative strategies for effective management. This paper constructs an agent-based simulation system, to explore innovative GUM strategies. The preliminary results of Shanghai UGM practice show that the proposed DeciUrban can address the challenges in the further development of GUM.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis way based on CLEAN algorithms in Squirrel Cage Induction Motors
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Among the methods of fault diagnosis based on the current analysis for Squirrel Cage Induction Motors (SCIM), the fault characteristic components are often submerged by fundamental component and noises, especially for the broken rotor bars. The CLEAN algorithm is a kind of relaxant data processing algorithms for additive noises and system errors. A new approach based on CLEAN algorithms for fault diagnosis and monitoring in SCIM is proposed in this paper. the CLEAN algorithm is used to extract the characteristic components for the fundamental one of power, and estimates the discrete-time spectrum parameter of particular fault from the continuous spectrum of the noise and mixed waves, which can eliminate the effective of power and noise and highlight the fault characteristic components. At last experimental results have demonstrated the effectiveness and advantage of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: The design of Low-Pass Filter based on MegaCore functions
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper have proposed a filter design method based on MegaCore functions. Moreover, the design and verification of finite impulse response (FIR) Low-Pass Filter is exhibited based on the Simulink platform from The MathWorks. The optimized implementation of FIR filter provides high quality signal processing at reasonable cost. Firstly, the paper analyzes filter theory and filter design method based on MegaCore functions. Secondly, the paper presents FIR Low-Pass Filter's design and test based on the Simulink platform from The MathWorks.

articleTitle: A brief analysis on the reformation and exploration of basic computer education for sports training major
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Elementary computer training for sports training major is a well worth studying problem in basic computer education. Because of the overall weak liberal basis of sports training major students and the existing disparity in individual variations, there are many problems in teaching them computer basis. After the teaching process of this major and probe of experiments designing, this article introduces the methods and tactics to tackle these problems from various angles and try to use these means to overcome the difficulties and obstacles to achieve a more ideal teaching objectives.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The cognition process of training transfer: Viewpoint of organization innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The applying of EWB in teaching of electronic technology
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The paper discusses the problems of traditional teaching of electronics technique foundation. The necessary of Electronic Design Automation(EDA) acid teaching is discussed. The main function of Electronics Workbench (EWB) is introduced. And the applying of EWB in theory and experiment teach about electronic technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of two group signatures based on bilinear maps
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Group signatures are broadly used to build E-voting, E-binding and fair E-cash systems. In 2004, Boneh et al proposed a short group signature (BBS04) and a group signature with verifier-local revocation (BS04). Both schemes are based on bilinear maps. In this paper, we revisit and improve them. The security of the revisited BBS04 scheme can be directly derived from the improved BS04. Our analysis is helpful to unveil the psychological activities during designing the two signatures. This will promote the techniques for analyzing cryptographic protocols.

articleTitle: The design of image acquisition and display system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The FPGA with Avalon Bus architecture and Nios soft-core processor developed by Altera Corporation is an advanced embedded solution for control and interface systems. a embedded system with A CCD data acquisition system and a VGA display module is very common in the industry design. With the rapid development of embedded systems, in particular the development of high-speed image processing, displaying the real-time image processing is very important. Based on the principle of VGA display, abandoning VGA display dedicated chip and using SOPC (Programmable System-on-Chip) technology, embed Nios II 32-bit processor soft-core in the FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Arrays) chips, Through programming the image acquisition module, DMA control module, VGA display and control module, VGA image acquisition and display controller is designed. VGA display system based on this method is a small size, low power consumption and high reliability.

articleTitle: EasiBridge: A generic web-enabled service-based middleware for heterogeneous wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN) are getting increasingly attractive as a means to bridge between the physical and the virtual world. The current trends in communication see vast advances in wireless connectivity, leading to dynamic and complicated systems on top of which applications must be built. The task of designing these applications with such systems thus becomes much more complex. One common problem faced by the designers is the heterogeneity of the software and hardware platforms which makes deployment and application development difficult and time-consuming. Therefore, there is a need for a generic middleware for flexible, fast integration and deployment of such heterogeneous sensor networks. This motivates the development of EasiBridge, a message-transformation service-oriented middleware for WSNs. The main objective of this work is to allow heterogeneous WSNs to be supported through a common middleware platform.

articleTitle: Survey and countermeasure on undergraduates' disorientation in internet —case study of Jiangxi normal university
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: As a typical problem of learning in Internet environment, disorientation undoubtedly has adverse impact on e-learning. Via survey on the undergraduates' disorientation problem of Jiangxi Normal University, this article discloses the real situation of undergraduates' disorientation in the process of their e-learning, analyzes the related factors that may cause disorientation, and then proposes countermeasures on the basis of the survey analysis.

articleTitle: The Web asynchronous communication mechanism research based on Ajax
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Ajax implements data exchange between a client and a server though the asynchronous communication mechanism, which is a research hotspot belongs to a Series of web2.0 technology. This paper analyses the technical features of Ajax WEB communication mechanism, and apply it to the B / S structure of the teaching management system design. In practice, Web pages through the JavaScript call Asynchronous Ajax engine load data, not only lightened the burden on the server and bandwidth, and improve the user experience.

articleTitle: Post mining of non-redundant association rules for sensor data estimation
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Association mining can produce many association rules. It is widely recognized that the set of association rules can rapidly grow to be unwieldy, especially when the support requirements are relatively low, making it difficult for end users to identify those that are of particular interest to them. Therefore, it is important to remove insignificant rules and prune redundant information as well as utilize the discovered information for meaningful purposes in different applications. Many researchers have considered various kinds of solutions to the above problem. For example, to efficiently mine association rules based on frequent itemsets; to mine interesting association rules based on user-specified constraints; to mine non-redundant association rules. However, the number of produced association rules is still in a large amount and not all of them are useful for the end users' requests. In this research we focus on post mining of non-redundant and informative association rules that match the user interests. The generated association rules are then applied to sensor network databases of a traffic monitoring site for missing data estimation purpose, in which data missing by a sensor is estimated using the data generated by its related sensors.

articleTitle: Science data based astronomy education
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Virtual Observatory (VO) is meeting the challenges resulting from the large new influxes of data in astronomy. Worldwide Telescope, as an embodiment of VO, provides a powerful science data based education environment for educators and students. In the paper, the critical requirements for science data based education are discussed; VO and WWT and their features are introduced; and experiences learned from astronomy courses based on the WWT at Central China Normal University are given out. The experiences indicates that WWT is a wonderful tool to astronomy teaching and learning, it made teaching more active, aspiring, interesting, visual, vivid and different from traditional teaching.

articleTitle: The proposal of ontology as a part of University data warehouse
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Main goal of this paper is the proposal of modified university ontology as a part of University data warehouse. The existing ontology does not include all the required concepts and information that are necessary in the evaluation process. In a first step, university ontology is needed to define the base classes that become entities and their associations. After design phase and verification of class diagrams that present our proposed ontology, the mapping into the Data Warehouse multidimensional Star Schema is presented. The most valuable contribution (after implementation phase) will be the possibility to online evaluate the study achievements of students either individually or globally for a departments and faculties according to various parameters, which will undoubtedly increase the quality of pedagogical process. And it should decrease student failure rates.

articleTitle: Broadcast learning system using multicast address
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Nowadays, teaching and learning process using computers becomes inseparable process, especially on information technology department. The teaching process often occurs on the laboratory, which is every student will do the learning process in front of a computer. A computer can help the learning process but also can disturb the learning process because student can be distracted to do something else. Therefore, this research will develop server and client applications to help control the process of learning and teaching that give on a computer laboratory by broadcast everything that show on computer server monitor to each client. The server can also control the keyboard, mouse, monitor and terminate or block an application that run on computer client. This application will be build using Microsoft Visual C#. Testing results showed that the number of clients does not affect the bandwidth consumption and CPU usage at broadcast. The smooth multicast depends on several factors such as type of image compression and resolution sizes. Selection resolution size and type appropriate image compression is recommended that more real-time multicast.

articleTitle: An auction agent architecture for mobile commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Auctions achieved enormous popularity in the e-commerce and had a great success. M-commerce makes use of wireless networks to provide personalized and location-based services to users. This project investigates the feasibility to using mobile agents from mobile wireless handheld devices. We have developed a J-phone auction agent architecture for mobile commerce. This approach overcomes wireless network limitations, and assists users to monitor bidding status and implements bidding decision at multiple auction sites.

articleTitle: Implementing statecharts using Java enums
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Statechart, which is one of the important diagrams in Unified Modeling Language (UML), represents reactive behavior of a class of objects. Implementing statecharts has been difficult for programmers because the commonly used object-oriented programming languages do not support statecharts at the language level. In this study, we present a new approach to implement statecharts using Java enums. Each state is represented as an enum-value. The whole statechart behavior is encapsulated within the Statechart class. This class is nested inside the owner class of the statechart. The resulting code is object-oriented, efficient and well-structured.

articleTitle: Assessment information management from Health Houses to the Health Center of Qazvin in 2008
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The basic condition to successful in health information management is précis and regulation assembling of information and sent of them in optimal situation to decision and policy making. This is a descriptive study which was conducted in 2008. Population research was 3 levels of Health System of Qazvin. By targeted sampling; 10 Health Houses, 5 Rural Health Centers and Shahid Bolandian Health Center of Qazvin city were selected to study. A questionnaire and checklist were used for data collection and assessment information management. collected data were analyzed with spss13 software. This study indicated that 7.3% of total information was sent to higher level. Information management were assessed in data collection and information transfer: weak (0%), moderate (23.2%) and fair (76.8%), data processing and analyzing: weak (0%), moderate (15.9%) and fair (84.1%), interpretation of information: weak(1.4%), moderate(23.2%) and fair(75.4%), also method of data control: weak(0%), moderate(21.7%) and fair(78.3%). With respect to large amount of information generated in different levels of health system, appropriate screening is very important to managers and policy makers for the best decision making.

articleTitle: Case-based teaching for the course of Visual Basic Program Design
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Program Design is the first course to understand the kernel theory and the programming thought for the freshmen. If they can study well, they will have a good foundation to study later, keep interest to the computer programming. Otherwise they maybe lose interesting to study programming even be afraid of it. In order to improve the effective of teaching, keep students more interest to this course, a new method of case-based teaching is introduced in this paper. By analyzing the process of case teaching, the article talks about some problems in teaching organization and practice on computer, supplies some methods of improvement. The idea and characteristics of the case teaching method are introduced, the feasibility of the case teaching in Visual Basic programming is analyzed, and the organizing and implementing process of the case teaching activity is also demonstrated in virtue of a specific ATM teaching case. Guided with appropriate teaching theory, the teaching activity can be more intentional, and the expectant teaching effect can be gained more easily.

articleTitle: The application of digital storytelling in teaching evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In foreign countries, digital storytelling as a teaching method has been widely used in various disciplines. Because of its own characteristics it has distinct advantages in teaching while compared with traditional teaching methods. This paper, based on document research, introduces the relevant concepts and elements of digital storytelling, applies digital storytelling to the processual evaluating in order to compensate for the shortcomings and deficiencies of traditional methods, portfolio evaluation. The article shows the application mode of digital story used in teaching evaluation by demonstrating a case, providing guidance for relevant research. Finally, the paper points out the problems we should focus on and looks on the follow-up studies.

articleTitle: Research on an intelligent knowledge service system based on internet
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Knowledge service is a deeper level of knowledge service. The paper analyses the tutoring requirements of junior high school students, puts forward an intelligent tutoring program base on knowledge service, and establishes the Web Intelligent Tutoring Knowledge Service System (WITKSS). WITKSS uses automatic reasoning based on knowledge to realize the intellectualization and automatization of the tutorship of objective mature problem, uses the technologies of computer, database and natural language understanding based on domain to realize the information transform and interconversion between numerous users and the system. Moreover, WITKSS provides real-time online operation mode, can better meet the tutoring needs of junior high school students. Nowadays,WITKSS has been in on-line service, is a useful attempt of the knowledge service system solving specific problems in real life.

articleTitle: An analytical optimization algorithm based on quantum computing embedded into evolutionary algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Optimization is one of the most primary jobs of all the engineering problems. We are fortunate to have blessed with scores of methods available for optimization purpose. Evolutionary algorithm is fast becoming one of the most sought after methods for this purpose. This method depends upon random moves. So sometimes the time consumed by this algorithm is much more than expected. With an aim to get rid of this problem, in this paper we propose an entirely new approach of evolutionary algorithm based on quantum computing. A quantum evolutionary algorithm can be termed as a concept which utilizes certain tools of quantum computing for search and optimization purposes. A quantum algorithm relies heavily on qubits and quantum gates. Qubits are the entities which actually contain information in quantum computing. They can either remain in a secluded state or a superposition of two or more qubits states. When they are in a superposition state we employ the concepts of probability to predict where they can actually be found. On the other hand quantum gates utilize qubits to achieve some predefined goals. These predefined goals in case of an optimization problem are to maximize or minimize some sort of objective function. This paper proposes a novel evolutionary algorithm employing quantum computing to address optimization problems. We have tested our algorithm on a famous problem known as Gear Train Design Problem. The results so obtained outperform the classical optimization methods.

articleTitle: Usability testing on a government training platform: A case study
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Self-regulated learning (SRL) plays an important role in most life-long training projects. In SRL, easy and flexible interaction with system is a primary factor impacting learners' motivation and outcomes. The purpose of this study is to evaluate a government training platform with Performance Analysis and User Perception methods to investigate the system's efficiency, effectiveness and satisfaction. In this study, efficiency and effectiveness were evaluated by Time on Task and Task Completion score, and satisfaction was evaluated by Questionnaire and Interviews. Based on our findings, this article identified the main design problems that frustrated learners and distracted them from learning tasks, and provided some suggestions for interface design of e-Learning platform.

articleTitle: To innovate the teaching of software engineering in order to train student's creative thinking idea
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: To train student's creative thinking idea has important significance. Because the exhibition of creative thinking at software engineering field is very outstanding, so the software engineering is one of the best courses training the creative thinking idea of students. For helping teachers to understand the close relationship between the software engineering and creative thinking, some examples have been analyzed, the examples show that creative thinking drive the development of theoretical knowledge of software engineering. “The teachers should strengthen the creative thinking idea of students while imparting software engineering knowledge” is put forward. In order to strengthen the creative thinking idea of students, the teaching innovation of software engineering should carry on. The concrete contents (about innovating teaching content, innovating teaching methods, innovating examination content and mode) are introduced.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comparison of problem solving with problem posing learning models of student learning outcomes in the concept of the periodic system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The design of online Database Experiment System
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In this paper, a Database Experiment System (DES) based web was introduced to provide the students an easy and convenient learning environment. The aim of the DES will easily make the students to experiment database by a browser on a computer terminal linked to Internet anywhere rather than in a special laboratory. There are a rich test questions in the system and every questions will be based a special project. The online experiment function lets the students run SQL scripts repeatedly until satisfy their requirements. Another more important advantage is that the experiment data can be assessed by the system automatically. The DES adopted the method of Object-Oriented modeling with UML and is composed of a 3-tier architecture based on B/S. All the applications' design and coding are based on the architecture of Microsoft. Net in the system. The Façade pattern is introduced to achieve security of the system. The DES consists of five functions and they are Manage Users, Manage Test Questions, Manage Experiment, Value Experiment and Experimentalize. The design of the Machine of Assessment as the most important function of DES was particularly discussed in the paper. It fulfilled valuing the students experiment data automatically by the computer and mark the experiment. The DES has applied for two academic years and achieved a satisfied result.

articleTitle: Dynamically maintain the teaching examples of triggers and stored procedures about the course of database application
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Triggers and stored procedures have an irreplaceable importance in the teaching process about the course of database application, as them can realized a complex program logic and can test student's comprehensive application ability to SQL languages. At present, all kinds of management platforms of DBMS (such as the Enterprise Management) are still some inconvenient aspects: when the users want to input the description information of triggers and stored procedure, Enterprise Management appeared to be inadequate; when users want to track the modified-process of triggers and stored procedures, EM did not provide such a feature; in particular, EM manages to triggers with dispersibility that can't to meet the needs of centralized management. These problems lead a teacher to difficult to manage the teaching examples library of triggers and stored procedures dynamically in the teaching process about the course of Database Applications. We developed a simple visual management platform(based on the C/S computing model) with SQL SERVER 2008 & Visual Basic 6.0, to realize the dynamic maintenance of triggers and stored procedures about the database of Student, which include: (1) to provide a user-friendly visual interface to show with concentration and query with detail information for triggers and stored procedures; (2) to input, query, and modify the description information of triggers and stored procedures; (3) to provide a user-friendly visual interface to track dynamically the modified, inserted, and deleted process to teaching examples of triggers and stored procedures. The results significantly increase the work efficiencies and improve the teaching effects to the teachers about the course of database application.

articleTitle: Experience and ideas on basic computer teaching in independent colleges
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: With the particularity of basic computer education in independent colleges and the target to train computer application talented person into consideration, this paper expounds the author's experience and ideas on the teaching content, teaching method and teaching measure in basic computer teaching in independent colleges as well as the author's teaching reform practice and exploration.

articleTitle: A model for information technology education for undergraduates of engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper presents a model program for information technology education for undergraduates of engineering in China. The model consists of three key elements such as a well-defined curriculum, teacher preparation programs, and research in information technology education. This paper lays emphasis on teaching strategies. The model is aimed at increasing student interest in studying information technology as a discipline, and becoming computer literate and computer competent.

articleTitle: The applying research for 3D mesh models watermarking based on 3D MAX
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: A 3D mesh models watermarking scheme based on 3D MAX is proposed. In 3D MAX, object is transformed to mesh model. The vertexes and surfaces of mesh model are analyzed. The selected insert points are the vertexes which are associated with less acute angle of right triangle. Embedding watermark uses the LSB method. Experimental results show that the scheme's invisibility is good under the little scheme's loading and low time complexity. Moreover, the scheme has good applied value. It can protect the copyright of 3D works.

articleTitle: Mean square error minimization using interpolative block truncation coding algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Block Truncation Coding (BTC) is one of spatial coding techniques of images. This technique has a simple and fast algorithm which achieves constant bit rate of 2 bits per pixel. The compression ratio may be improved by coding only half of the bits in the BTC bit plane of each block; the other half will be interpolated at the receiver. The resulting bit rate will be 1.5 bits per pixel. In this paper, two proposed interpolative algorithms for coding the block truncated image bit plane are presented. Several grey scale test images are used to evaluate the coding efficiency and performance of these algorithms compared with existing algorithms. It is generally shown that the proposed algorithms give better results.

articleTitle: Data-oriented architecture of sine
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: A data-oriented architecture is introduced to calculate Sine function by using sine data-oriented model as a data structure and a small calculation unit. The main contribution of this paper is to use a content-accessed memory to handle and manage data-oriented model of sine in this architecture. Using this architecture, sine function calculation will be fast.

articleTitle: Effective use of audio-visual equipment and materials in classroom teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: An outstanding development in modern education is the increased use of supplementary devices by which the teacher through the use of more than one sensory channel helps to clarify, establish and correlate accuracy, concepts, interpretations and appreciations; increase knowledge, arouses interest and even evokes worthy emotions and enriches the imagination of children. The investigator made an attempt to study the availability of audio visual equipment and materials in the schools and their effective use in classroom teaching. The study was undertaken in twenty-one higher secondary schools of Nellore town of Nellore district, Andhra Pradesh, India. Three questionnaires were used to find out the availability of audio-visual equipment and materials and their effective use in classroom teaching and a check-list was used to identify the factors hindering the effective use of audio-visual equipment and materials in classroom teaching. Besides these an identification data schedule seeking the information on the variables was also given to 105 teachers working in 21 schools of different managements. Chi-square test was followed for the study. Data shows that the position of audio visual equipment was poor. Computers, television, tape recorder, public address equipment were possessed by only 47.62 per cent of the schools. The variables like type of management of schools, age of the schools, medium of the schools and strength of the schools have no influence on the possession of the adequate or inadequate equipment in the schools. 90.4 per cent of schools have effectively used the audio visual equipment. The school administration is not taking any effort to procure and utilize the audio-visual equipment and materials in a right manner as it is difficult for the managements to meet the maintenance cost of audio-visual equipments as the schools are poor.

articleTitle: A novel location method of characters in container codes
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper presents a novel method to locate container code characters. This method is based on top-hat transformation and gray beep points. Our aim is to locate the position of container characters, to prepare for the segment and recognition of container characters. It has to deal with outdoor images. This work is part of a higher order project whose aim is automation of the entrance of a port.

articleTitle: The research on virtual reality applied for digitalize education of mining engineer speciality
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In order to meet the need of digitalize education of university mining engineer professional, the VR software Multigen creator was developed as platform to design three dimension model, Vega was designed on scene drive tool and visual c++ was developed as platform mining virtual emulation system was developed in values of texture mapping, LOD, instance, crash detect technology and so on. The user make use of mouse and keyboard to control mining all kinds of equipment movement through three dimension model movement control interface programmer to have function of real emulation and runtime control. The system is not only applied for student studying and education research, but also safety succor, accident simulation and investigation analyze and so on and is a successful application example of VR used by virtual education.

articleTitle: Design an active e-learning system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Active learning provides a powerful mechanism to enhance depth of learning and get learners involved with learning process instead of passively participate in it. And e-learning get popular with the advances of the Internet. The objective of this paper is to design a kind of active e -learning system. In this paper, the design basis including students' requirements, related experiences and system design engineering are analyzed firstly. And then, we proposed the workflow of the system and designed the function modules of the active e-learning system. The designs focus on students' activeness and include most active learning function or tools. To test the system effect, we conducted a beginning application in e-commerce course. Related data proved this kind of active e-learning system is welcomed.

articleTitle: Innovation and practice of National Quality Course of “Automatic Control System”
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Quality Course construction is an important part of the quality project construction of the Ministry of Education. In this paper, the history and the building process of “Automatic Control Systems” course are introduced firstly; then the reforms and innovations of this course, teaching philosophy, curriculum design and teaching process organization, teaching methods and means, is elaborated in detail. Practice has proved that, through the building of the National Quality Course, the quality of other courses is improved and demonstrated, and the quality of teaching of the whole university is enhanced.

articleTitle: FAST-MANDARIN. 2: As an interactive multimedia supplementary instructional tool
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Information technology has been developing fast and of late, many have tried to tie education in with it. The advent of technology provides exposure and encourages everyone to seek information via technology such as multimedia. Therefore, a language instructor would need a full complement of supplemental resources to assist preparation for class, conducting lectures, assessing students' performance and others in order to teach effectively. One of the new developments in language teaching pedagogy is to employ interactive multimedia supplementary instructional tools. The FAST MANDANRIN.2 CD-ROM serves as an interactive multimedia supplementary instructional tool and is self-produced by the researchers. The objective is to supplement conventional teaching and learning method of the Elementary Mandarin-learning program in Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM). Besides, it is offered as a self-paced learning instruction for the students in view of the limitation of contact hours for third language classes in the university. It was clear from the results of the research that interactive multimedia has the capacity to illuminate and enhance the teaching and learning process of Elementary Mandarin.

articleTitle: Design of transport vehicles remote monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: To improve the level of supervision and management for cargo transport vehicles, especially trucks carrying coal, it is important to develop transport vehicles remote monitoring system. The system uses GPS, GSM/3G, GIS, computer network communication and data processing technology, installs a variety of state sensors on truck, uses embedded intelligent terminal based on ARM9 to obtain states of the cargo vehicle, and achieve real-time acquisition, transmission and analysis of these parameters in the remote monitoring center. Through a dynamic monitoring of the transport vehicles, manager can ensures that the vehicles are traveling in accordance with the approved lines. Once vehicles appear in accident, manager can quickly locate the accident point, implement treatment timely. It has provided a powerful management support with a rapid reacting capacity for the regulatory authorities, transport companies by information technology.

articleTitle: Teaching programming technique with edutainment robot construction
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Recently, building robot has become the current trend for the teaching and learning the subject of science in elementary and secondary education. The objective of this paper is to propose a teaching approach for programming language by the application of weblog on robot building. It is hoped that such an approach may make learning more enjoyable as well as effective and may further motivate students in future experiments. A study of teaching computer program in high school with VPL-based tool to construct robots was presented. Students formed in team to build robots and write program to perform the specified task. The result shows that students have achieved good results in terms of learning motivation.

articleTitle: Application of arithmetic CAP2 in medical diagnosis expert system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: With the social progress and the continuous development of artificial intelligence, medical diagnosis expert systems have become an indispensable supplementary means of medical. Expert system knowledge acquisition is one of the methods of machine learning, inductive learning to develop a more mature one. This paper selected medical diagnosis of Parkinson's disease cases, the use of induction learning algorithm ID3 improved algorithm CAP2, the rules extracted them to build expert systems knowledge acquisition process, and achieved good results.

articleTitle: Recognizing Persian license plates in digital zoom condition
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In this paper, we propose an algorithm of license plates recognition from their images captured by a camera in digital zoom using a binary time delay neural network (TDNN). Moreover, hard conditions such as the distance and angle variations as well as weather and light conditions are considered. For training the neural network, we collected the training images using the Zernike moment when the camera was not in the magnification state and the test images when the camera was in zooming state. The comparison was made between the proposed algorithm and the previous methods in character recognition like SVM and classical TDNN. The algorithms have been evaluated using 50 license plate images with magnification of 8. The recognition rate obtained by the proposed algorithm was 70%.

articleTitle: Augmented tagging system for annotating and sharing videos on mobile device by bar scanner and social media
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Social media is very useful for collaborative learning because of their sharing and flexible nature. Many learning activities can use social media to facilitate the processes, such as collaborative writing, brainstorming, and live presentation streaming. Some instructors have paid attention to the popularity of social media. Social media is very simple and intuitive for users with information literacy on desktop computer. Also, social media is very popular on mobile devices, such as PDA and smartphone. Although learners can receive information for collaborative learning from social media on mobile devices, they generally tend to response simple text on mobile devices and complex interactions on desktop computer. This paper suggests another inexpensive way to enable complex interactions on mobile devices by integrating social media with a digital camera bar scanner. Consequently, a learner can annotate a video clip on a mobile device by cards with QR code. After everyone finishes recording, all clips with annotations can be uploaded into a social media system for sharing. Thus, an augmented tagging system is constructed for learners to response complex messages on mobile devices. Finally, a semi-structured expert interview was conducted to evaluate the system.

articleTitle: Emphasizing experiences in teaching software engineering courses
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Using software products as engineering artifacts is becoming more widespread in industry. It leads to increasing the need for training students and experts in the academic centers with software developing skills in accordance with the engineering principles and disciplines. However, one of the main challenges in the software engineering education is how to teach engineering disciplines to the students so that we can inspire the engineering concept to them. To do so if we use educational methods for teaching this course, which can show the usage of engineering disciplines to the students in practice and demonstrate the impact of their application on creating the engineered software products, we will achieve more qualified and engineered products in the future.
