To accommodate the application of engineering notion at different stages of the software development lifecycle, we have proposed an experience based approach in this paper that can help teaching software engineering principles and practices through experiments. Reviewing the results of the experiments by students will be helpful to learn software engineering concepts and use them for developing more engineered software.

articleTitle: Euclidean distance-ordered thinning for skeleton extraction
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The skeleton is an important feature for the representation of a shape in image analysis. In this paper, we propose a novel Euclidean distance-ordered thinning algorithm for skeleton extraction. We first give the deletion templates which can determine a given pixel to be safely deleted or not from the pattern of its 8-neighbors. Then we delete the points which satisfy the deletion templates until there is no point that can be deleted in the linked lists of ascending order. Finally, the skeleton of the object is obtained. The experiment results show that the algorithm is able to extract the connected and one-pixel wide skeleton that can correctly preserve the topology of the object. Furthermore, the extracted skeleton locates on the accurate position and it is insensitive to boundary noise.

articleTitle: A experimental platform for process operation system based on data integration
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The degree of automation is high in process industry. In order to find solutions to complicated technical problems in chemical product development and manufacture process, an experimental platform is presented for process operation system information integration. In this paper, the theory and methodology of information integration of process industry is discussed. A data integration model is presented based on XML and STEP technology. An automatic chemical platform is implemented based on information integration method. And the features of the platform are introduced. As a research platform to manufacture product in kilogram-scale, was designed especially for fine and specialties chemicals in batches. The function of process operation is investigated in coupled with computer aided monitoring and operation process optimization. Finally, in order to verify the information integration approach and the performance of the platform, a case study on nipagin ethyl ester process is carried out.

articleTitle: Covariance tracking algorithm based on particle filter and adaptive template update
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The region descriptor and template update strategy are the keys of object tracking algorithm. In the paper, we proposed an adaptive template update method based on region covariance descriptor to track the object in a complex circumstance using particle filter. We experimented the proposed approach on people in video sequences, and experimental results show that this method has better performance.

articleTitle: Application of computer-based RP biomodelling in clinical orthopaedic surgery education
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) biomodels are essential for clinical orthopaedics. In this study, in order to improve the outcomes of orthopaedic surgical intervention and its clinical medical education, an advanced computer-based rapid prototyping (RP) biomodelling technique was used to fabricate 3D real size physical models of complex cases including highly difficult fractures and severe bone and joint deformities. As a result, the RP-produced vivid models made great contributions to achievement of much better understanding and preoperative planning for complex orthopaedic cases. On the other hand, outcomes of clinical medical education for orthopaedic residents and junior doctors were improved.

articleTitle: An application multimedia to the teaching of biostatistics
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: With the fast development of information technology, more and more multimedia technologies are widely used in different fields of education. This paper introduces an optimal course system by using multimedia technology in the teaching of biostatistics. The optimal course system is composed of situational teaching, Computer-Assisted Instruction (CAI), network teaching and interactive teaching. The course system aims to reform traditional teaching and enhance teaching quality and effect of biostatistics. Compared to traditional mode, multimedia teaching is composed of diversified teaching methods to enhance students' learning interest, deepen the understanding of the teaching content and strengthen student's ability to analyze problems and to solve problems.

articleTitle: A fuzzy rule based intelligent advisor for self-paced learner in e-Learning environment
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper presents a scheme for intelligent advice generation with the help of a fuzzy rule base, meant for a self-paced learner in an e-Learning environment. It employs a fuzzy machine that is fed with performance parameters e.g. score and time pertaining to a computer aided assessment of learner's learning achievement. The fuzzy machine processes these performance parameters with the help of a fuzzy rule base to produce the crisp measures of the learner's cognitive states in terms of knowledge, understanding and skill. On the basis of these defuzzified crisp diagnostic parameters advice is generated for the learner to suggest his future course of action targeted towards achievement of his learning objectives.

articleTitle: Two energy-efficient and timesaving improvement mechanisms for network reprogramming in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Network Reprogramming is very necessary to wireless sensor networks. We give two mechanisms, sender selection mechanism and permanent mechanism, making Network Reprogramming timesaving and energy-efficient. Network Reprogramming usually includes three processes which are image pretreatment, image distribution and image reloading. To make the image distribution more efficient, we give a sender selection algorithm based on Influence, Distance and residual Energy. Simulation reveals that after adopting this algorithm, the classic code distribution protocol Deluge has almost the same completion time as before, but produces less messages and saves more energy. On the other hand, completion time and energy cost has direct ratio with the image size to transmit. In order to reduce the image size, we keep some universal functions such as the image distribution fixed in the sensor nodes and design the permanent mechanism sending only application module and relative basic function modules. Simulation shows that this mechanism remarkably reduces the energy cost and completion time.

articleTitle: On the security of blind signature and partially blind signature
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Blind signature allows a user to obtain a signature from an authority on any document, in such a way that the authority learns nothing about the message that is being signed. The blindness is an important property which distinguishes the blind signature from other signature schemes. Partially blind signature is an extension of blind signature that allows a signer to sign a partially blinded message that include pre-agreed information in the resulting signatures. Recently, Liao et al. proposed a pairing-based provable blind signature scheme without random oracles, and Hu et al. proposed an efficient ID-based partially blind signature scheme with security proof. But in this paper, we show that the two schemes do not satisfy the blindness and partially blindness, respectively. Liao et al.'s scheme is linkability and in Hu et al.'s scheme, a malicious user can replace pre-agreed common information with a special information

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A program based on compression and difference transmission for image acquisition in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Bipedal robotics: A nanotechnology and neurotechnology approach
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Bipedal robotics is a field referred to chiefly developing humanoids and other biologically inspire two legged robots, due to the complex mechanisms and decision making processes involved in physical activities of human beings we require highly reliable sensor modules and high precision high frequency processor platforms for near to real time response of the bipedal robots (bipeds). Since in human beings the entire decision making process and control signal triggering actions are taken care chiefly by Brain neurons, their unmatched parallelism is far from reality to be realized by conventional processors. The novel approach to such a problem would be using brain neurons itself for processing of data and making decisions. The recent lab results published by Johanna Varner of MIT have shown that occipital and cortical neurons can be cultured efficiently in the lab on a silicon substrate. This paper discusses the technique of using lab cultured (in vivo) occipital and cortical neurons for image processing and motor control.

articleTitle: Personalized recommendation system based on multi_agent and rough set
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Recommendation technology is an important technology to solve problems of information overwhelmed. However, recommendation system has many shortages such as lack of ability to discover knowledge hidden in data of users' online behaviours, poor personalized service, weak recommendation efficiency and effectiveness. In this paper, we put forward a personalized recommendation system based on multi_agent. We use JADE to build a learner agent (LA) and three types of recommendation agent (RA). RA takes advantage of rough set theory to discover pattern of user's interest based on user's online behaviors. We adopt Lucene to analyse materials, which are accessed by users, and extract information from them in order to build decision table and support RA to carry on knowledge discovery work. In the meantime, we use Lucene to build personalized retrieval function to support recommendation. The system integrates advantages of various recommended methods combining with the advantages of knowledge discovery work. Experiments based on real data show that this mechanism can recommend proper learning resources to users.

articleTitle: Dynamic pairwise key establishment algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: A new dynamic pair-wise key establishment algorithm without requiring keys pre-distribution is proposed. In the scheme, each node does not require any pre-assigned keys before deployment, and after deployment, for any two nodes, they will establish a different direct pair-wise key between them dynamically during each session. Theoretic analysis and simulation results show that the probability of direct pair-wise key establishment of our new algorithm is 100%, which is much higher than those previous traditional pairwise key establishment methods. Furthermore, it is distributed and has good security performance also.

articleTitle: Design and implement an interconnected VPN system for campuses in multiple geographical locations
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper presents a novel design and implementation of a VPN management system. A central point of control is created to schedule and provision access to not just one but multiple VPN servers that are gatekeepers for campus remote laboratories of institutions from different geographical locations. After VPN tunnels are created, users are able to control and operate on both PC and non-PC components of the lab through the internet. The presented system provides a complete student lab access solution. Students are able to use the lab anytime from anywhere there is an internet connection. Lab resources of all the participating institutions are consolidated into one larger resource pool; therefore the efficiency of lab resources being utilized is greatly improved. The same equipment consolidation concept can be extended into various STEM(Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) fields, resulting in a broad impact on STEM education.

articleTitle: Keyphrases extraction research based on structure of document
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Keyphrase is the foundation of text categorization, automatic summary and information retrieval, so the research of automatic keyphrase extraction has important significance. The current keyphrase extraction methods don't take full advantage of the structural features of the document, too much emphasis on the importance of term frequency, which result in the low accuracy of keyphrase extraction. According to these, the paper proposed a keyphrase extraction method based on structure features of the document. It combined with term frequency, location and length information to automatically extract keyphrases.

articleTitle: Research on self-adaptive learning system based on memory model
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper explores the forgotten rules of psychology into adaptive learning system to estimate the learner's learning situation of knowledge, and thus to provide a reference for the development of learning strategies. It also studies the application of data mining to establish student's memory model, based on which researchers raised an adaptive learning system and designed an implementation model.

articleTitle: A study on the application of modern education technology into constructing College English autonomous learning platform and reinforcing the cultivation of English proficiency
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Based on the strengths of modern education technology, psychological cognition theory, the second language acquisition, autonomous learning theory and modern English testing studies; this study has explored the construction of College English autonomous learning platform and reinforcing the cultivation of English proficiency under the network environment.

articleTitle: Research on traffic layout based on social network analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In modern society, city's traffic problems are always receiving great attention. How to carry on the traffic layout well is just one of important and rudimental subjects. This paper works over that subject based on a new approach of social network analysis (SNA), which absorbs the knowledge in social science. In the social network analysis, three measures (degree, closeness and betweenness) are introduced, which represent the amount of direct adjacent roads, probability of vehicles that come from all directions, and cut points where traffic flows are restricted separately. What's more, basing on those three measures, the paper gives a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method for the traffic layout, which can show the characteristics of traffic network and reveal the operation efficiency of the traffic. At last, through a practical case, some values about traffic layout based on social network analysis are approved.

articleTitle: Analysis of image fusion and classification for high resolution SAR data on-line
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: SAR and optical remote sensing image, with highly complementary characteristics, can enhance the integration of information utilization of remote sensing data. Adopting the new Cosmo-Skymed SAR high-resolution image data, we inhibit speckle impact using enhanced Lee filtering. Then we fused this image with a CBERS image using local use standard deviation based on wavelet packet method. Because of fully integrating the characteristics of each image, it can retain the spectral characteristics and details of properties to the maximum extent, improve signal-to-noise ratio, and be conducive to information extraction. The experiments show that the automatic classification accuracy significantly increased and classification Kappa coefficient increased from 0.47 to 0.93 after fusion of Cosmo-Skymed and CBERS02 data. Meanwhile, This paper employ a geospatial information processing concept model complied interoperable system framework and an implementation approach for accessing geospatial information openly by chaining individual service module to assemble complex geospatial processing and executing the processing model to deliver information.

articleTitle: Pre-service teachers' reflection in reading of literary texts in weblogs
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This qualitative study examines twenty-five preservice English language teachers' reflective level in their reading of literary texts. 189 weblog entries were analysed. The five levels of reflection identified were Identification, Association, Integration, Analysis, and Transformation, with Identification and Association levels considered a ‘surface learning’ while the remaining three as ‘deep learning’. The results indicated while the percentage of reflection at all levels was almost equally distributed, the combined percentage of the ‘deep learning’ constituted almost seventy percentage of the total number of weblog entries. This outcome indicated that weblogs were useful for reflection of reading literary texts.

articleTitle: An online examination system supporting user-defined question type
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The online examination system not only reflects the justification and objectivity of examination, but also releases the workload of teachers, which is accepted by more and more schools, certification organizations and training organizations. Most online examination systems only support several fixed question types and don't allow users define their own question types, so they have pool scalability. This paper proposes a new online examination system, which not only provides several basic question types but also allows users to define their new question types (user-defined question type) through composing of basic question types and/or user-defined question types, which is realized based on the object-oriented conception and composite design pattern. The new online examination system overcomes the shortcoming of old online examination systems and has better extensibility and flexibility.

articleTitle: A second-order Gm-C continuous time filter in mobile radio receiver architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In this paper the design of a CMOS second-order butterworth low-pass Gm-C filter for baseband communication is presented. In the analog signal processing, the anti-aliasing filter would be one of the most important circuits in the transceiver architecture. The second-order butterworth Gm-C low-pass filter using the proposed transconductore is simulated in a 0.18μm CMOS process. In this project, we have minimized the power consumption of the anti aliasing filter. The circuit consumed 384.44μwatt through a 1.8V power supply with a cut off frequency 24MHZ.

articleTitle: Improving an interactive simulator for computer systems with learning objects
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In the 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century, learning is a crucial activity through which people can assimilate or acquire new knowledge. However, many existing e-learning systems contain complicated knowledge structure that hinders the reuse or sharing of knowledge. In a previous project awarded by the Microsoft Research Asia, we successfully developed an interactive simulator to facilitate the learning of essential concepts related to computer systems through live animations. Here, we propose to integrate learning objects and relevant technologies into our interactive simulator to illustrate the underlying knowledge structure and, more importantly, facilitate the sharing and reuse of relevant concepts. Through adopting the IEEE learning object metadata (LOM) standard, our simulator can easily exchange relevant learning objects with other e-learning systems. The system design and prototype implementation of our LOM-based simulator is considered in this paper to evaluate how general and experienced users can benefit from our LOM-based simulator in various ways.

articleTitle: The design and development of computer network quality course website
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: During the construction of computer network quality course to improve the quality of computer network course, the paper designs and develops the computer network quality course website. The development of the website is based on B/S architecture and MVC design pattern and adopts the Struts framework. The website is enough to incarnate the user-centered development idea and provides an excellent intercourse platform for teachers and students. The paper shows the design of the website function modules, and specifically describes the development of main function modules and the update and maintenance of the website.

articleTitle: The green space monitoring system based on Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: We present to use Wireless Sensor Networks(WSNs) to monitor environmental factors for ubran green space. By using a wsn, the real-time distribution of temperature and humidity gathered from the real environment clearly reflects the dynamics of temperature and humidity both inside and outside the green space. Meanwhile, the data of the heat absorbed and the humidity released by urban green space can also be obtained. Finally, it is obvious that temperature and humidity were different inside and outside the urban green space, the green space has a positive effect on cooling and humidifier, and the trend of the changes in the temperature and humidity is gradually “pervasive” from east to west.

articleTitle: Learning activities design of a blended learning course based on public internet
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Blended learning provides a new idea and method for the university teaching and learning reform. The blending learning course of “Human Learning and Cognition”, which was built mainly on Google collaboration platform (Sites), adopted the Google group, micro-blogging and instant messages to provide learning support services. Taking the learning basic theory chapter of the course as an example, the paper offered some practice propositions using some web2.0 tools to design blended learning activities in public Internet environment from the activity objectives, activity resources, activity organization and activity evaluation.

articleTitle: LGL-DIR: Layout graph for layout based document image retrieval
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In this paper, a system for retrieving document images from digital library based on visual similarity of them is proposed. First, a graph layout created based on document extracted blocks. This graph represents document layout structure. A vector created based on path patterns to represent this graph. Then, self organizing structure is used for indexing of images in the database. This method allows us to retrieve similar images without direct comparison between the query image and database files. Experimental results on a variety of document image databases confirm the feasibility, validity, and efficiency of our proposed approach in visual based document image retrieval.

articleTitle: Messages segmentation of asynchronous text-based discussion in social network analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Social network analysis (SNA) is often employed by teachers and researchers to analyze online asynchronous discussion in e-learning to serve various purposes regarding the communication structure of the group and other structural characteristics of the discussion forum. Usually, SNA determine the level of participation in online asynchronous discussion based on number of messages even though this message consist of only one word or one sentence. However, it is not fair for participants who send or post a message that consist of several sentences. The main idea to handle these problems is to segment the message into sentences unit, which will be more appropriate than their equivalent message. This paper discusses the difference between the SNA result using message and it equivalent sentences as unit interaction. The visual representation of the interaction in a map and graph are demonstrated and explained. It also describes the message segmentation procedure to break a message into sentences and examine whether sentence as a single unit of interaction can satisfy the assessment of participation level in SNA. The result shows that sentence unit able to determine the students' participation in more objective way compared to messages in term of communication structures in online discussion.

articleTitle: Research of the bilingual teaching mode based on computer courses in the Ordinary Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In order to enhance the bilingual teaching, the ministry of education of P. R. China had given documentation in 2001. Bilingual teaching has regarded by each university, but the practice of bilingual education courses, the effects and not too satisfactory. In this paper, the form of a questionnaire survey to research how to improve bilingual education in bilingual teaching and learning performance and avoid injury disciplines based on computer courses in the Ordinary Colleges and Universities.

articleTitle: Research on web-based multimedia resources system for ethnic minorities' nonmaterial heritages protection
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The protection of ethnic minorities' nonmaterial heritages is becoming a new focus of culture protection in China. For trying to explore a new way of protecting the ethnic minorities' nonmaterial heritages with the help of information technology, the research in this paper describes the designing and fulfilling route and methods of web-based multimedia resources system of ethnic nationalities' nonmaterial heritages. Though the system, people collect, reorganize, and propagate the nonmaterial heritages in such digital resources as pictures, audio files, video files and etc. It is a 3-layer structure system, Meta-data and comprehensive retrieval technologies are applied in it.

articleTitle: A hybrid method for task scheduling
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Task Graph Scheduling is an NP-Hard problem. In this paper a new hybrid method based on Genetic Algorithm and Learning Automata is proposed. The hybrid method begins with an initial population of randomly generated chromosomes. A chromosome is Equal to learning automaton. Each Chromosome by itself represents a stochastic scheduling. The scheduling is optimized within a learning process. Compared with current genetic approaches to DAG scheduling better results are achieved. The main reason underlying this achievement is that an evolutionary approach such as genetics, looks for the best chromosomes within genetic populations whilst in the approach presented in this paper hybrid algorithm is applied to find the most suitable position for the genes and looking for the best chromosomes too. The scheduling resulted from applying our hybrid algorithm to some benchmark task graphs are compared with the existing ones

articleTitle: User ID provisioning for SIP registration in IMS
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: SIP registration is needed prior to communicating with SIP terminal in IMS core network. The approach introduced in this paper provides the capability to provision the user identifier assigned to a specific terminal which depends on the user location by NACF (Network Attachment Control Function of IMS). It serves two purposes: avoiding any need for user interaction; avoiding fraud.

articleTitle: H∞ performance for a class of uncertain linear time-delay systems based on LMI
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: By using linear matrix inequality approach, this paper deals with H∞ control problem for a class of uncertain linear systems with time-varying state and control input delays and normbounded parameter perturbations. A sufficient condition for such system to be robust stabilization by state feedback is obtained based on LMI approach. Moreover, the result is not only stabilizes the time-delay system, but also makes the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> norm of such closed-loop system to be less than a given upper bound.

articleTitle: Research and practice on the cultivation mode of compound mainframe software talents with engineering practice background
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: According to the readjustment of national industrial structure, the demand for talents on mainframe and strong profession in mainframe applications, Dalian Jiaotong University, taking advantage of our own Cultivation, combines mainframe technology with our school compound dual professional software talents training model. Meanwhile, with an integrated curriculum teaching methods and integration process and associating with relevant courses, we build a mode of curriculum chain so that students can master the knowledge about relationships among all courses, and solve synthesis problems. We focus on applying structures “Platform + Module” in the course structure, designing rational course modules, and strengthening capacity-building. Meanwhile, we have long-term cooperation with IBM and others' mainframe industry's well-known enterprises at home and abroad, and invite teachers with background of engineering practice into the classroom, and build a practice base with company. With the purpose of enhancing students engineering training and designing capacity-building, we focus on building teaching and training system of “learning by doing” that requires engineering practice background in engineering compound mainframe software talents. It has been proved that this new compound mainframe training mode can meet the requirement of social development, and continuously improve the school's quality and effectively enhance students' practical applications ability.

articleTitle: Intergration or information technology in nursing simulation training
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The healthcare workforce is increasingly moving towards the global adoption of computer applications and technology for effective and efficient delivery of healthcare services. This emphasizes the need to integrate the use of information technology especially the electronic medical records (EMR) into the learning process of the health professions student, thereby exposing them to the use of EMR at each level of their studies; therefore, the medical students would be familiar with and better prepared for the use of the complex technologies for effective medical operations as they enter the workforce. Despite the growing importance of EMR, health professions students in medical schools in the US have been given little or no hands-on training on electronic medical records during their course of training. Nova Southeastern University (NSU) in Florida USA has six healthcare professions colleges, including medicine, nursing, dentistry, pharmacy, and other allied health professionals; and has been an ideal ground for collaborative projects in teaching and training. This NSU-Nursing Simulation Lab EMR project, with an initial focus on the nursing students, was a collaborative effort between the graduate students in the Medical Informatics Program and Nursing Program at NSU. As a practicum requirement, the medical informatics graduate students assessed the needs of the nursing simulation laboratory for the electronic medical records; based on the analysis, the graduate students developed and implemented the customized EMR for the nursing students and faculty training. The platforms of Microsoft Access, SQL statements and Visual Basic Application language were used to provide a practical and interactive electronic medical record for the nursing simulation experience. A functional and secure EMR was developed and implemented in the NSU nursing simulation laboratory, and it is being integrated as a part of daily training of using current information technology for the nurses in training at NSU now. Both medical informatics graduate students and the nursing students have gained practically useful hands-on experience through this innovative project. Healthcare professions students' competency and comfort levels of using information technology when they enter the workforce will be further investigated to demonstrate the significance of this innovation.

articleTitle: Applications of Matlab in the teachings of electronic major courses
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: There are many abstract concepts and mathematic theory in electronic major courses which are difficult to understand, thus killing students' interests in learning. This paper discusses the applications of Matlab which is used to assist teaching of electronic major courses. The practice shows that the emulation by Matlab not only visualizes the abstract theories but also improves students' comprehensive ability and quality, increases teacher's teaching means, so as to enhance classroom teaching effect.

articleTitle: Detecting cheering events in sports games
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper proposes a unified method to deal with the problem of detecting cheering events in audio stream of live sports games. In our framework, first, a sliding window is used to pre-segment the audio stream into short segments by moving from start to the end. Second, various kinds of audio features are extracted to represent different audio sounds in each segment. Third, GMM (Gaussian Mixture Model) is used as the classifier to detect cheering events. Finally, in addition to widely used smoothing rules, this paper developed a new boundary-seeking smoothing algorithm to overcome the shortcomings of conventional sliding-window based analysis method and eliminate the false alarms caused by background noise. By integrating all the techniques, an average F value of 82.99% is achieved in the cheering detection task evaluated on eleven games of five kinds of sports. In this study, we discuss the complementarity of various kinds of audio features for the cheering event detection task. We also compare the result with the HMM based event detection framework. Based on our study, we conclude that for long-term audio event detection such as cheering event detection, sliding-window based framework gives more satisfied result.

articleTitle: Innovation for the course of C language to embedded platform
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The course of C language in the specialty of the computer science and technology is transferred to the embedded platform to prompt the teaching effect. Correspondingly, Keil C is used as the development environment, and the new experiment board with a serial of external peripherals is designed based on the 8051 family MCU. The case teaching method is adopted to increase the appeal, in which the full knowledge of C language is trained. By forming the practical systems or devices with C language on the boards, the students' passion is stimulated for programming due to their recognition for the power and practicality of C language. At last the students are familiar with C language, and begin to cognize the embedded system.

articleTitle: Implementation of agricultural training system using Game Engine
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: With the further researches on technologies in agriculture informationization in China, training systems based on these technologies got much development in recent years. However, there are still many problems in these systems, such as absenting interest. This paper uses classic Ceres-Maize model as maize growth model and Game Engine to develop an interactive agricultural training system based on four-layer architecture. Moreover, the system applies the idea of game design and advanced 3D technologies and achieves visualization of training. This application of interactive training has good prospects in popularization of agriculture knowledge.

articleTitle: Traffic status estimate based on data fusion
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Traffic information estimation is one of the most functions of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS). At present, it is estimated based on single data source, especially GPS data. The average speed of floating cars is generally utilized to evaluate the route status. However, the speed can not always represent the real traffic status, and usually leads to misjudge. Thus, Multi-source should be evaluated to acquire more accurate estimate. In the paper, Rough Sets Theory is utilized to fuse different data to more accurately estimate the traffic status, including current GPS data from uplink and downlink lanes and historical data. An example is also presentd.

articleTitle: Construction of university Collaboration and Learning Environment (CLE) Based on open source software sakai?
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Sakai as a flexible, powerful and open Collaboration and Learning Environment (CLE) based on J2EE framework, has gradually been introduced into the school for practice. This paper introduces the installation of Sakai and its localisation and the coordination teaching.

articleTitle: Variable frequency hydraulic speed control system based on CANopen
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper combined hydraulic transmission, frequency speed control and CAN bus communication together to establish variable frequency hydraulic speed control system. Inverter, PLC, sensors communicated with each other with CANopen protocol in the system. The system could vary speed in a wide range, control the motor speed precisely and improve the response time and stability of hydraulic system. The variable frequency hydraulic speed control test platform was built, two cylinders pulling reverse was adopted as a way of loading to test the system's speed control performance, we found that the motor response time equaled to the inverter acceleration or deceleration time. The actuator response time mainly depended on the motor response time, the hydraulic pump output flow and cylinder size. Low-frequency performance of the system was analyzed, the minimum static frequency under different loads of the system was obtained through experiments.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Implementation and configuration management model for quality enhancment in higher education
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Model construct and case study of interpersonal interaction in virtual learning community
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Based on the interaction among the members of virtual learning community, the social computing software is a powerful tool. Exploring the connotative features of the model construction and the application process of the Interpersonal interaction among the community members from macro theoretical perspective to micro technical perspective will deepen understanding and value judgments of educational technology about social computing.

articleTitle: Development Of Expediency Fuel Consumption Cost Simulator
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper focus on the development of Expediency Fuel Consumption Cost Simulator (EFCCS). EFCCS is automated software that calculates the total amount of fuel cost for a car to travel based on the distance given, driving speed, weight capacity and current market fuel price cost. This software simulator has been developed by using Visual Basic. Net language and SQL Server database system. By deploying EFCCS, users obtain a summary and the best solution to estimate the minimum cost towards the desired destination.

articleTitle: Study on after class teaching of Data Structure for undergraduates
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The paper analyzed teaching circumstance of Data Structure for undergraduates in Chinese, indicated the shortages in teaching and the problems which students faced with when continuing their learning after class, introduced our exploration in after class teaching of Data Structure for undergraduates who major in computer science and technology at Shijiazhuang Railway Institute. It includes project driving teaching mode, application based teaching contents, and some methods such as open teaching, tutor system, scientific research, programming contest, and so on.

articleTitle: A new method on studying the motion reliability of planar four-bar linkage
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: A new analytical method on the motion reliability of planar four-bar linkage is proposed. In this method, its mathematical displacement model is established firstly, and then original errors are assumed as the random variables. The reliability model is established using the probability method in three cases which are the bar length errors, the bar length errors and joint clearance errors, and the bar length errors, the joint clearance errors, and hinge wear errors. The motion reliability is analyzed and calculated by the theoretical calculation and computer simulation. The effectiveness and application value of the new analytical method are further verified by an engineering example.

articleTitle: Design scheme of Distributed Dynamic Route Guidance System
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Distributed Dynamic Route Guidance System(DDRGS) is composed of Vehicle Mounted Unit, traffic control center and wireless communication network. When this system is used, control center has light duty, communication infrastructure needed few, and can take effect quickly. Information component, function, structure and developing method of DDRGS are analyzed. It suits the situation of China. The software and hardware of developing the system are determined. Road weighted value scheme is given.

articleTitle: New method of finite element analysis for Headstock
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Headstock is one of the most important parts in the high-speed NC center; it plays a great part in the working process of the NC center. This paper presents a method using ANSYS Workbench to analyze the Headstock, including modeling, applied load and post-process. In addition, it also refers to a comparison among different constraints to prove them as the important parts in the finite element analysis of the Headstock. Finally goal driven optimization of Headstock is carried out. By comparison the performance of Headstock is enhanced greatly.

articleTitle: On the priority problem of CAN protocol: A new idea
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: CAN is one of the widely-used control network protocols in industry. In spite of its any advantages, it has a number of drawbacks such as its priority, message latency, and bubbling idiot problems. This paper introduces a novel “event-triggered” control protocol, named in this paper as `counter-CAN', denoted by C-CAN. The protocol is defined and evaluated. For evaluating the performance of C-CAN, two indices have been defined: timing performance and node latency. These indices have been used for the evaluation of conventional CAN and C-CAN in three scenarios. Experimental results showed that performance of the C-CAN is better than that of the conventional CAN in terms of both reliability and response-time indices. The paper has also showed that the novel protocol overcomes the priority and message latency problems of CAN.

articleTitle: Empirical study to measure index in ability of response to the antidumping — Basis on the questionnaires
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Response to the antidumping is not only related to the development of enterprises and the gain of personal benefit, it is also related to the economic security of the country and industrial reconstruction. Through the measurement of the response antidumping ability, and improve the performance of response antidumping, it can ensure the country's interests as well as the development of enterprises. So taking factual needs as starting point, using relevant research result home and abroad, the thesis suggested 13 initial variable index of measurement which are multi-dimensional to measure the response antidumping ability. And then, choosing the measure index by forecast tries and the guide tests, established the ultimate index variables, and carried out factor analysis on the data. The empirical result indicated that measure index designed to response to the dumping ability owns fine reliability and validity.

Author Keywords: the ability of response to antidumping

articleTitle: Intelli-log : A real-time log analyzer
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In this paper, we present a technique to analyze and correlate the different types of computer log files. Log files are generated from servers and network devices to record operations that occur in the computers and networks. As log files are too enormous to manualize, we develop a tool to maximize accuracy as well as efficiency while high speed processing is the goal. Firstly, we must improve the accuracy by using learning algorithms to classify the normal operations from the abnormal ones such algorithms include tf-idf, association rules, k-means clustering, and decision tree. Secondly, we may adapt for less accuracy in order to gain speed for both with and/or without parallel processing techniques. We also construct an adaptive learning algorithm to update the model. Then we flush out out-of-date model while the logs are being captured and processed. The result can achieve the goal as they can reach about 30-40% in real-time processing with nearly zero false positive results.

articleTitle: To improve the social interaction of Web-based Collaborative Learning via online Educational Games for multi-player
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper discuss the relationship between the Educational Games and Web-based Collaborative Learning, and provide the methods how to use the Educational Games to improve the social interaction of the Web-Based Collaborative Learning. And analysis the case of Unigame in application.

articleTitle: Neurofuzzy prediction for visual tracking
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Real time visual tracking is a complicated problem due the different dynamic of the objects involved in the process. On one hand the algorithms for image processing usually consume a lot of time on the other hand the motors and mechanisms used for the camera movements are significantly slow. This work describes the use of ANFIS model to reduce the delay's effects in the control for visual tracking and also explains how we resolved this problem by predicting the target movement using a neurofuzzy approach.

articleTitle: Comparing simulations and graphical representations of complexities of benchmark and large-variable circuits
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In this work, we analyzes the relationship between randomly generated Boolean function complexity and the number of nodes in benchmark circuits using the Binary Decision Diagrams (BDD). We generated BDDs for several ISCAS benchmark circuits and derived the area complexity measure in terms of number of nodes. We demonstrate that the benchmarks and randomly generated Boolean functions behave similarly in terms of area complexity. The experiments were extended to a large number of variables to verify the complexity behavior. It was confirmed that the rise of the complexity graph is only important to calculate the circuit complexities.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Designed and kinematics simulation of hot-press module mobile on the Continuous belt vulcanizing machine
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the framework of new college English teaching mode integrating cooperative and autonomous learning in the network multimedia environment
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: By analyzing the basic theories, the core concepts and the interconnections of cooperative learning and autonomous learning and organically integrating the advantages of these two learning theories, an overall framework of a new college English teaching mode is designed, which integrates cooperative learning and autonomous learning in the network multimedia environment. The framework is a completely new college English teaching mode organically formed by the combination of cooperative learning groups, the network platform and studio (forum), which provides a reference for achieving the goal of college English teaching and improving the students' learning efficiency.

articleTitle: The muffler suspension parts forepart fatigue damage problem study and improvement design
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Finite element method is utilized in this article to analyze the muffler suspension parts forepart fatigue damage problem, and an improvement design is presented according to stress distributing map and invalidation property of the connecting parts. The engineering practice indicates that the improvement design could solve the forepart fatigue damage problem very well, and improve the variable stiffness of the joints.

articleTitle: Task Driven Learning model and application on teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Task Driven Learning (TDL) carries out the teaching by the task so that students greatly enhance the enthusiasm and initiative. This paper proposed the operation process mode of TDL and an application scenario of the operation process model, which are focused in training professional knowledge, emphasizing problem-solving skills, self-directed learning skills and team skills.

articleTitle: Research on microcomputer serial courses diversified teaching mode
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Microcomputer serial courses are the courses with applicability and practicality. At present, the teaching mode of this kind course is unitary and students' practice ability is poor. Teaching reforms carried out in Henan Polytechnic University is reported in this paper. Various ways are employed, including constructing innovative and practical teaching system and adopting diversified teaching mode. In the new teaching mode, we adopt diversified teaching and experiment forms, carry out multi-level teaching activities and pay attention to student's ability cultivation. It greatly develops the students' comprehensive application capability and innovation consciousness. Significant effect has been obtained with our reform exploration.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Exploration of practical teaching system of clothing subject and improvement of educational mode of Enterprise Base
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Fuzzy synthesis judgment evaluating model of Graduation Design
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The primary role of Graduation Design (Thesis) is examined the comprehensive application ability and innovative ability of the students of what they have learned comprehensively. The students of Software Engineering need to write a thesis based on the project besides complete the actual project, however, the traditional evaluation methods can't meet the actual requirement. Therefore, this paper offers a method to evaluate the graduation design of Software Engineering which based on secondary fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. This method evaluates synthetically the Graduation Design of the students from the point of advisor, experts and reply group, which can evaluate the students' achievement reasonably, fairly and comprehensively, and it's accepted by students and teachers.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The research of improving innovate ability from smart car game about Automation specialty students
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on image quality assessment methods based on human visual sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Image quality assessment study becomes one of the crucial basic topics in image information. We propose a new approach for image quality assessment, which indicates the image quality synthetically with kinds of factors such as image ambiguity, correlation and luminance extracted by wavelet transforms. Compared with the traditional criteria for image quality, the experiment results show our method can achieve a more comprehensive image quality assessment performance, and fit for human visual sensitivity much better.

articleTitle: Achieving learning object interoperability and reusability through object orientation
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Throughout the literature there is significant evidence to show that in general the goals of learning object reusability and interoperability are not being met very well. In this paper we discuss how object orientation can be applied to the learning object concept to improve interoperability and reusability. In particular we show how features of object orientation such as inheritance, polymorphism, information hiding and instantiation among others play a significant role in interoperability and reusability in a theory of learning objects presented in a previous paper.

articleTitle: The application of “Situated teaching” in the courses of digital media major
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: “Situated teaching” which links the knowledge and authentic tasks enables students to complete the situational projects by teams. The characteristics and teaching methods of “Situated teaching” is suitable for vocational college courses which are more practical and strong operable.

articleTitle: Application of flash games to primary CAI courses
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Scholars in educational technology have paid attention to the design and development of multimedia educational software. However, the traditional educational software can not effectively stimulate student interest in learning or increase motivation. Basing on the psychological characteristics of students, it is proposed to apply flash games to the design and development of primary CAI courseware, so that students can acquire knowledge with pleasure during the game. The results showed that the flash game-based educational software can enhance student interest in learning, strengthen the motivation and extend the duration of interest.

articleTitle: On the development of an experimental car-like mobile robot
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper is devoted to design and implement an intelligent scaled car-like mobile robot that possesses the capability of autonomous driving in an extra-road environment and fully autonomous parking on standard parking lots. The final goal is to design a robotized system that is able to process in real-time large amounts of sensor based data, to choose a collision free drivable trajectory thru detected obstacles and to wirelessly exchange information with a host PC.

articleTitle: Creating opportunities for students in active learning: Lessons learnt from an Electronic Design Contest
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Active Learning is seen as a fundamental improvement of traditional teaching. This paper investigates the China's National Undergraduate Electronic Design Contest creating opportunities for students in active learning, to become problem solvers and to reflect upon their own learning. We use a qualitative research method to investigate students' experience in contest, and describe the curricular impact of the contest in colleges.

articleTitle: Design of DSP-based valve leak detection system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Based on the principle of acoustic emission, piezoelectric sensor is used in valve leakage signal acquisition. After signal conditioning module for acquisition of the original signal, filtering and amplification would be done. On this basis, using DSP TMS320LF2407 as the core of the micro-control system to achieve signal acquisition, signal filtering and processing functions, as well as communication with the host computer by RS-485 bus. The valve leak detection system design and development is realized, which come up with a great help for the safe operation of the tunnel, be conducive to testing and maintenance of the valve, moreover reduce the operator workload.

articleTitle: A novel robust and fast segmentation of the color images using fuzzy classification c-means
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper brings out a method for segmentation of color images based on fuzzy classification. It proceeds in a first step by a fine segmentation using the algorithm of fuzzy c-means (FCM). The method then applies a test fusion of fuzzy classes. The result is a coarse segmentation, where each region is the union of elementary regions grown from FCM. The fuzzy C-Means (FCM) clustering is an iterative partitioning method that produces optimal c-partitions, the standard FCM algorithm takes a long time to partition a large data set. The proposed FCM program must read the entire data set into a memory for processing. Our results show that the system performance is robust to different types of images.

articleTitle: Prediction and assessment of student learning outcomes in structural mechanics a decision support of integrating data mining and fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper focuses on the issue of continuous improvement on educational outcomes and takes the engineering mechanics course as an example to help students overcome their learning difficulties. A decision support system based on data mining and fuzzy logic is proposed to predict the student learning outcomes. The methodologies involves four steps: fuzzy theory to identify the factors on learning outcomes; data mining to construct influence diagram; machine learning to establish the fuzzy inference relations; and the model to predict the exam scores at the beginning of course and thereby to help students enhance their scores according to their weakness.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Thinking and strategies to construct aesthetic experience of children
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The working process simulation of human - parachute system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Capacity based codebook with MMSE for MIMO spatial multiplexing systems
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper deals with the design and analysis of code book construction for MIMO spatial multiplexing systems with limited feedback of channel state information. We present a capacity based codebook construction algorithm which consider average power and MMSE constraint. The close form solution of optimal transmission scheme with code book are derived, and the optimal precoder structure is also employed in this paper. Simulation results show that the capacity based codebook construction algorithm with power allocation and multi-mode beamforming can achieve higher capacity than existing codebook.

articleTitle: Computer based virtual instrument technology developed practical ability of undergraduates
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: On information times with the scale expansion situation in university, in order to develop undergraduates' practical ability and meet needs of talent for social development, the teacher should explore new ideas for practical teaching. This work inspires undergraduates to design their own comprehensive experiment by using the advantages of virtual instrument technology. Virtual instrument is a demand for the organization in accordance with instrument data acquisition system. It is a computer instrumentation systems with the general-purpose computer as the core hardware platform, designed by the user who defined functions, with a virtual panel, the test functions was realized by test software. This method optimizes practical teaching, develop the innovation ability and shape the quality of modern engineering of undergraduates.

articleTitle: Design flow for data transfer system development by the example of QPSK base-band system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In this paper we use the design flow technique in addition to hardware-in-the-loop using FPGA and applied these techniques for the QPSK base-band system. The proposed model and technique have proved to be good specially in the minimization of the “human factor” in the conversion of mathematical model to hardware. The paper covers the full development cycle from a mathematical model to a bit-file. For the purpose of illustration for the proposed design flow, development of a quadrature phase modulation narrowband data transfer system (QPSK system) is reviewed step by step in this paper.

articleTitle: Practice and research on the bilingual teaching demonstration course
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The introducing of bilingual teaching in colleges and universities is the need for training excellent and internationally competitive people. According to the experiences and ideas in the processing of national bilingual teaching demonstration course construction in Delphi computer high-level programming technology, this paper analyzed the key factors influencing the quality of the bilingual teaching, including the faculty of bilingual teachers, textbooks and teaching methods. Through the practice of bilingual teaching, the teaching team try to make the students competent in their specialty field and cultivate high-quality innovative talents with international competivity.

articleTitle: A maximum likelihood based genetic algorithm for inferring haplotypes from genotypes
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: A haplotype is a set of single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) from a given chromosome, and provides valuable information about complex diseases. Current practices that the inferring of large scale SNP haplotypes from raw SNP data (genotypes) using computational approaches has gained a lot of attention, but it presents a grand challenges as it is inherently a NP-Hard problem. In this paper, we propose a heuristic approach, Genetic Algorithm (GA) model for the haplotypes inference method, based on the maximum-likelihood estimates of haplotype frequencies under the assumption of Hardy-Weinberg proportions. The goal of the genetic algorithm method is to obtain high prediction accuracy within a reasonable computing time. The performance of our model was evaluated on both simulated datasets and real datasets, and these results are promising, indicating that our model is a potential computational tool for haplotype inferences.

articleTitle: Single-link serial Directional Rumor Routing in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The Rumor routing is a routing algorithm based on propagating software agents with random motion in wireless sensor networks. Rumor routing schema is based on the encounter of query agents and event propagator agents in sensor field. In this paper, we propose a new approach of rumor routing families that optimizes one of the newly introduced generations of rumor algorithm called Directional Rumor Routing (DRR). In our new approach, serial dispatching of query agents is suggested. Though, the routing energy consumption is reduced, but also some of shortcomings such as delays and path lengths are increased. Therefore, we combined it with single-link clustering method in order to statistically estimate new event area in the network. That is, having used this technique we, successfully, eliminated the aforementioned shortcomings. Simulation results show noticeable improvement in case of average energy consumption, and final route path over DRR.

articleTitle: Optimizing the information system of logistic distribution based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Based on the actual business processes of logistics distribution, a serious analysis on the needs for the center of city delivery information system was made in the paper, a solution to optimize the process of logistics and distribution was set up and it was achieved by matlab software.

articleTitle: Development and realization of digitalized Campus based on Mifare-1 Radio Frequency card
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Aiming at the work principle of the Mifare-1 Radio Frequency card, combining with the specific condition of Henan Mechanic and Electric Engineering College, the paper applies the intelligent Mifare-1 Radio Frequency card into Campus' Multi-function Card System and achieves the connection with campus card system using interface subsystems. The practices show that the application of this system is convenient for students.

articleTitle: The cultivating of innovation capacity and practice in SCM curriculum design
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Arounding the problems caused by innovation cultivation on the course named Single Chip Microcomputer Principle and Application, the authors carried out teaching reforms. This article analyzed the problems of the students' course design, introduced some measures to improve innovation ability. The teaching practice proved that these teaching methods could develop students' study interest and cultivate student' independent innovation ability. It improved students' comprehensive quality.

articleTitle: Research on the design and development of a web-based physics virtual lab for junior high schools
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Web-based virtual laboratories are promising to save experimental cost, to avoid danger, and to support collaboration and resource sharing. Based on the understanding of the concept, types and development modes of web-based virtual laboratories, this paper presents the design and development of a web-based virtual lab (IWVL) for junior high schools' physics teaching, especially experimental teaching. The design requirements, the design and development of virtual instruments, and functional components are highlighted in the discussions.

articleTitle: An approach for building the database of heterogeneous materials with a periodic microstructure
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: An approach for building the database of heterogeneous materials with a periodic microstructure is developed in this paper with the help of database management system, a performance estimation module, and a microstrucutre design module. Using this approach, material data of HMPMs can be managed availably, material properties of HMPMs can be estimated effectively, and unknown microstructures of HMPMs can be designed correctly for obtaining the special material properties. Thus, this approach is an effective database creation method for HMPMs, which simplifies the database building process of HMPMs, greatly reduces the research time of HMPMs, and has the important guiding significance for developing the unknown HMPMs.

Author Keywords: approach for building the database of HMPMs

articleTitle: Verification and research of a Wimax authentication protocol based on SSM
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: WiMAX is a new technology providing broadband data access to mobile as well as stationary users. Standards for Mobile WiMAX (IEEE 802.16e-2005) has already been finalized. In IEEE 802.16, security has been considered as the main issue during the design of the protocol. In this paper, a new WIMAX authentication protocol is designed to better satisfy the security goals under the WiMAX security architecture, then a formal correctness proof of the protocol is presented based on SSM. Finally, its performance is analyzed and improved.

articleTitle: Appication of a mixed method in bio-fish path planning
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: To the Goal Nonreachable with Obstacles Nearby (GNRON) in the application of the bio-fish path planning based on artificial potential, this paper adopts a method which combines artificial potential field with fuzzy logic, and designs a fuzzy logic controller. When the bio-fish runs into trap situation, fuzzy control algorithm is switched to get the bio-fish out of the trap situation quickly and swim to the goal. With the method, the bio-fish achieved an obstacle avoidance experiment in global environment. The experimental results show the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: The effect of shape and weight towards the performance of Simple Adaptive Median filter in reducing impulse noise level from digital images
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Recently, Simple Adaptive Median (SAM) filter has been introduced for the purpose of reducing the impulse noise level in digital images. SAM filter, which uses square filter as its basis, has an ability to change the size of the filter, spatially, based on the approximated local noise level. This paper investigates the effect of shape and weight into the performance of SAM filter in terms of quality improvement, and also execution time. In this work, SAM filter has been compared with its three new derivatives. These three new methods are Circular SAM (CSAM), Weighted SAM (WSAM), and Weighted CSAM (WCSAM). For the purpose of evaluation, fifty test images of size 1600 × 1200 pixels have been used as the test images. The results show that the performance of these methods is almost identical. All methods successfully restore the images corrupted up to 95% of impulse noise. Circular filter and weighting process slightly improve the performance of SAM. However, circular filter dramatically increases the processing time due to its complicated implementation.

articleTitle: On fuzzy and interval-valued fuzzy subhyperlattice
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: We introduced the notions of fuzzy subhyperlattice and fuzzy ideal, listed equivalent conditions of fuzzy subhyperlattice and fuzzy ideal, concluded that the two different definitions of fuzzy ideal are equivalent, proved that the Cartesian product of two fuzzy subhyperlattices is a fuzzy subhyperlattice too and gave an example to show that the product of two fuzzy ideals may not be a fuzzy ideal. Then we generalized our results to interval-valued fuzzy version.

articleTitle: Optimization of Odd-Even Transposition Network
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This document is about optimizing one of the simplest sorting networks named Odd-Even Transposition Sorting Network. This network, because of simple structure, is very suitable to be implemented on two dimensional arrays of processors. In this paper, we consider the optimization of the aforesaid network. At the end we can see that with optimization the steps to be done for sorting a sequence are clearly reduced.

articleTitle: Research on personalized recommendation system in E-learning
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: With the information explosion in the internet,web personalization becomes more and more important on the web.The paper designs a Browsing Behavior Personalized Information Recommendation System(BBIRS). A recommendation strategy puted forward in BBIRS,whitch through mine the web logs and interactive data by offline and online separately,and the user's intersting degree on the page been caculated by its browsing speed. The system uses two recommendation algorithms according the different intersting degree.

articleTitle: ‘KhorasansDI’ an organizational initiative for the spatially enabled government development in Iran
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Accurate, relevant and accessible spatial information at the local level is critical to the delivery of many government services such as urban and emergency management. Also a key problem of organizations like National Cartographic Center of Iran (NCC) is that they produce - from time to time - some spatial data which is usually not included in any Spatial Data Infrastructure (SDI). Therefore we developed a GeoPortal - the KhorasanSDI - as one stop portal that gives the possibility to access and share such geodata produced by NCC. The KhorasanSDI is realized using open standards of OGC and ISO. It allows describing the geodata sets with metadata according to ISO 19115. This metadata can be queried using a Web Interface to a Catalog service and also using a bounding-box through a Web Map Service (WMS). Geodata itself can be accessed to the client directly though a Web Feature Service (WFS).

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The research on computational simulation in wind field based on some kind airplane
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Flexible teaching and learning to lifelong education for 21st century undergraduates
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A solution of mobile e-commerce security problems
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper first analyzes a vulnerable point, WAP Gateway, in the security conversation mechanisms of the mobile e-commerce transaction system; then, proposes an improved security solution on the WAP gateway based on the “double encryption model”. This solution can reduce the communication cost of the encryption consultations between mobile terminals and servers, shorten the time internal of consultations, and increase the connection speed and security degree in mobile e-commerce transaction.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Influence on teacher-student relationship with higher vocational curriculum reform
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In the higher vocational education reform, curriculum reform is a very important part of the reform. However, the establishment of new relationships between teachers and students is the premise of curriculum implementation and reform. Therefore, this paper analyzes the four stages of higher vocational curriculum reform.
