And base on the analysis, explores the characteristics of the teacher-student relationship under different curriculum modes. Then, this paper studies the link between the changes of teacher-student relationship and transformation of curriculum model. And finally, this paper analyzes Impact on the relationship between teachers and students under Vocational curriculum reform.

articleTitle: Research on a remote control vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In the paper,we created a wireless remote controlled car with a crash detection system. The car moves forward/reverse, left/right, and stops as the user desires. The user can also accelerate/decelerate using a joystick. The design allows for easy control of the toy car, and the ultrasonic sensors attached to the car body prevents any possible crashes into obstacles.

articleTitle: Design of sphygmus data acquisition platform based on wireless sensor technique
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: An frequently met intractable problem during the research of the imbedded sleeping monitor is the confirmation to different kinds of sphygmus signals. In order to acquire the different kinds of sphygmus signals accurately to provide reliable control information for actuators, a sphygmus data acquisition platform based on wireless sensor technique is proposed in this paper. The sphygmus signals of a body are transferred to a personal computer by wireless transform network. And the different sphygmus signals of the body can be displayed, stored and analyzed in terms of the abundant resource of the computer, which can provide sleeping monitor the reliable real data. It is indicated that the wireless sensor technique based sphygmus data acquisition platform is of such merits as simplicity, intuitionistics and accuracy.

articleTitle: Development of a simplified machine for measuring geometric parameters of end mills
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: A simplified machine for measuring tool geometry of end mills is presented in this paper. The images of the cutting tools were captured by a CCD camera and converted to digital signals through a software compression device, and then shown on a monitor. In addition, two linear scales were mounted on the X-Y table for the positioning and measuring purposes. The C++ Builder software was used for designing the human machine interfaces of the measuring system of end mills. Finally, a well-known tool measuring and inspection machine was utilized for measuring standard. This study makes a comparison between the measuring results employing the inspection machine and the proposed measuring system. Experimental results show that the percent of measuring error is acceptable for some geometric parameters of the square or the ball nose end mills. Thus the results demonstrate the proposed method is effective in measuring the parameters of end mills.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Practice for training creative ability on graduation project
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on attribute interval optimization method for segmentation based SVM and the Decision Tree Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In recent years, statistical learning theory ( for short SLT)and support vector machine(for short SVM) has become an international field of machine learning new hotspot. Decision tree classification learning algorithm is one of the most widely used and very practical inductive reasoning method, In machine learning, data mining, signal processing, intelligent control, artificial intelligence area has a very important theoretical meaning and practical value. It has been successfully applied Wide range of fields from learning medical diagnosis to assessment the credit risk of learning loan applications. Based on Decision Tree Learning and SVM has obvious advantages in their respective, the integration of decision tree and SVM learning will solve the problems that exist between the two effective ways to improve learning ability and decision tree classification performance, give full play to the advantages of both to make up for both insufficient to resolve the two difficult to solve long-standing problems. This paper based on support vector machine classification surface model and support vector point distribution, with the decision tree Classification surface and support vector machine Classification surface effective approximation as the basic starting point, explore new ways on the fusion of decision tree and SVM. Focused study based on support vector points and categories surface shape characteristics' attribute interval optimization method for segmentation in order to achieve the performance of decision tree optimization.

articleTitle: Intelligent interface for engineering design
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The design of large and complex equipment involves a good number of design software, which require and produce heterogeneous data. Viewing and managing data from various type and format poses a great difficulty for engineering designers. In order to solve these difficulties, we propose an intelligent interface system for handling heterogeneous design data. The intelligent interface system can understand and integrate data from heterogeneous data files. Data of different type and format can be specified, presented and managed in a unified way. From our system implementation we can conclude that our approach can greatly improve production efficiency of engineering designers.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The simulation and forecast of China education-economy system: Econometrics and system dynamics combining model
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Mobile robot fault tolerant control introducing ARTEMIC
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Real-time applications should timely deliver synchronized data-sets, minimize latency in their response and meet their performance specifications in the presence of disturbances and faults. The fault tolerant behavior in mobile robots refers to the possibility to autonomously detect and identify faults as well as the capability to continue operating after a fault occurred. This paper introduces a real-time distributed control application with fault tolerance capabilities for differential wheeled mobile robots, named ARTEMIC. Specific design, development and implementation details will be provided in this paper.

articleTitle: The research on party-line multi-hop self-organizing network
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In order to solve the problems existed in the traditional party-line single-hop network (PSN), such as short transmission distance and limited subscribers and etc, the paper proposed a new concept network “party-line multi-hop self-organizing network (PMSN)” using ad hoc technology. Firstly, the paper expounded the basic idea of PMSN and its advantages, also designed its general scheme. Secondly, the paper proposed a network synchronizing method based on minimum ID, and it resolved the slot synchronizing problem between network nodes. Thirdly, the paper proposed a topology updating technique based on two points orientation, and it realized the rapid, effective and reliable updating of network topology. Fourthly, the paper proposed a call and route control technique which has no collision, and it improved the success ratio of link building. Lastly, the paper simulated the performance of PMSN by OPNET, the simulation results proved that the PMSN had satisfying performance.

articleTitle: Research on Computer network course in Information Management and Information System
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Based on the problems of Computer Network teaching in Information Management and Information System, this paper studies teaching reform in Computer Network courses from the respect of teaching orientation locating, teaching content, teaching methods, experimental teaching, teachers building, and proposes a practical implementation plan. The teaching practice shows that basic theory combining with experimental projects in teaching process can contribute to train the application ability of students in the field of computer networks.

articleTitle: Cultivating undergraduates' English autonomous learning ability in multimedia network environment
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The integration of modern educational technology and English teaching became a necessity because of the rapid development of multimedia and network technology, the widening scale of undergraduate training, as well as cultivating innovative talents demands in the 21st century. Now teachers gradually concern about how to increase students' autonomous learning ability in the multimedia network environment.

articleTitle: Efficient path setup and recovery in wireless sensor networks by using the routing table
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Interest for wireless sensor networks has being increased in ubiquitous environment. In wireless sensor networks, each node sets up self-organization network, transfer the sensing data to sink node. Sensor nodes that compose sensor network are small size, and their battery capacity is limited. So, each node also imposes a constraint on search and recovery of data-path. In this paper, we designed a method to build data-path, considering restrictive features of a sensor node. Each node uses the routing table which consists of state information of a node and neighbors, to set up the data-path. Using the routing table, they can efficiently transfer the sensing data from each node to a sink.

articleTitle: A study on E-Learning systems integration based on multi-agent technology
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In recent years, there has been a growing interest to implement the integration of E-Learning systems running on different environments. And most of E-Learning systems are being designed based on client/server, peer to peer; and recently agent architectures. These systems have major drawbacks because of their limitations in scalability, availability, distribution of computing power and storage system, as well as sharing information between users that contribute in these systems. This paper will use the multi-agent technology to implement the cooperation and secure resource sharing among distributed individuals and institutions, and the different E-Learning systems. Every E-Learning system is encapsulated as an agent, then these agents can cooperate to implement a certain goal task, and at the same time, an E-Learning system integration platform is implemented by the integration of these agents.

articleTitle: Combinational backfilling for parallel job scheduling
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: FCFS is the most simple, basic and commonly used method of job scheduling in clusters. Backfilling scheduling that small jobs are moved ahead in the schedule can fill the resources gap that is generated by FCFS. However, existing backfilling scheduling algorithms are available for a queued job backfilled to schedule. The resources gap can't be fully utilized. A method of combinational backfilling for parallel job scheduling in clusters is proposed. It can select multiple jobs combined from the waiting job queue to backfill to maximize the use of idle resources. A comparison with FCFS, EASY backfilling algorithm is given. The results of experiments show that the algorithm proposed can attain the higher utilization of resources in the system than FCFS, EASY backfilling.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Thoughts on constructing lifelong education system for teachers in normal colleges and universities
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on HS-CDIO-based training model of Educational Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper took the demand for the talents of contemporary society as a starting point, and combining the characteristics of Education Technology, it proposed a new Education Technology training mode under the background of education reform which took the HS-CDIO as the philosophy, design of project as the carrier and learning of project as the method. The new training mode can dramatically improve students' practical abilities, team awareness and innovation abilities, and make them feel more self-confident in the fierce competition in the community.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Square Root Search
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The research in hand is an effort to introduce a new efficient searching technique known as Bidirectional Square Root Search, which is fastest then existing searching techniques including binary search in many cases. In this technique the number of element of the sorted list to be searched is reduced by exploring the list from both end simultaneously. Running Cost analysis and the result obtained after implementation are provided in the graphical form with an objective to compare the efficiency of the technique with binary search, as binary search is consider as an efficient and fast one.

articleTitle: I-core: An intelligent distributed system for users' credit card consuming
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: We present a system called I-core that not only provides the common functions, such as on-line payments and open accounts, but also shows its intelligence on data analysis, such as data classification, prediction and clustering. The conventional financial systems, like ATM and Electronic Banks, need very large databases for storing users' information. So does with I-core. We choose IBM DB2 Z series databases to store the information of users' credit cards. Furthermore, using our system, users can also access the results of classification, clustering and prediction based on their information of credit cards. This mostly differentiates from the other modern on-line financial service systems.

articleTitle: A task integration model for process operation system based on web services
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In recent years, a new distributed computing technology, which proposes the features of cross-platform, language independent, loosely coupled interaction and integration of heterogeneous applications, is becoming an urgent need for process industries with the popularity of internet application. In this paper, a task model is presented for process operation system information integration. A web service technology is applied to task model, and its advanced function and features compared to the traditional distributed integration technology are introduced. A case study of a mini chemical operation platform is used to verify the practicability and validity of proposed task integration model.

articleTitle: Cryptanalysis and improvement on three-party protocols for password authenticated key exchange
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Authentication and key exchange are fundamental for establishing secure communication channels over public insecure networks. Password-based protocols for authenticated key exchange are designed to work even when user authentication is done via the use of passwords drawn from a small known set of values. In 1995, Steiner et al. proposed a password-based authentication key exchange protocol for three-party, where the two clients trying to establish a common secret key do not share a password between themselves but only with a trusted server. Recently, Hung-Min Sun et al. proposed a attack on Steiner et al.'s protocol, and proposed a new key agreement protocol for three-party. They claimed their protocol prevented all kind of attacks. However, In this paper, we show that Hung-Min Sun et al.'s protocol is insecure. Furthermore, a new improved protocol is proposed.

articleTitle: On the bilingual teaching of computer networks
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Bilingual teaching plays an important role in the computer science curriculum. The necessity and urgency of bilingual teaching of “Computer Networks” course is discussed and analyzed in the paper, the bilingual teaching experiences over the last four years are summarized, and some strategies and suggestions for the bilingual teaching of the course are given.

articleTitle: Research on “data structure” teaching in Information Management and Information System
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Data structure is one of the core curriculums of Information Management and Information System. Based on the brief analysis of the problem in data structure teaching, this paper presents some methods to improve the teaching quality of data structure in theoretical teaching and experimental teaching. The practice shows that these methods are effective.

articleTitle: Education technology and computer sustaining professional Learning communities establishment in United Arab Emirates
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Professional Learning communities (PLCs) represent a fashionable topic for at least three decades now on the international education arena. This paper investigates this topic that has widely been considered on the international level, however it remained absent from the educational scene in the Arab region till now. Establishing learning communities relies heavily on education technology and availability of computers in the educational organizations. United Arab Emirates has got some trials - however immature - to practice establishing learning communities in some of its education organizations and this again is subject to the existence of education technology and computers in those organizations. In spite of this, United Arab Emirates and all Arab countries are invited through this paper to get acquainted with the features, vitality, and returns of establishing learning communities in their schools and universities.

articleTitle: Curriculum programme of career-oriented java specialty guided by principles of software engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: It has always been a challenge to justify a professional Java curriculum setting because of the diversity of this technology. Guided by the principles of software engineering, a philosophical-level solution is proposed. It suggests that JDBC course be excluded, and JSP course and SQL programming contents be simplified; in the mean time strengthen the learning of popular application framework and related software engineering theories. Compared to the pre-reformed curriculum system, the proposed programme covers more technological contents yet requires less class hour. Results on experimental class show that the proposed curriculum programme can lower the technical threshold while increase the practical ability of the students and the overall teaching effectiveness.

articleTitle: A new organization for Microprogrammed control units
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The control unit in chap 5 of computer system architecture by M.Morris Mano is designed by using Hardwired Control that in this paper aforesaid control unit is designed by using Microprogrammed Control, this control organization better than other control organization. This paper describes the main features of microprogramming to improve the performance of this computer systems.

articleTitle: Innovation experiment based on circular points and Laguerre theorem in computer vision
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The image coordinates of circular points calculation is one of the key technologies for camera self-calibration in computer vision. The definitions of planar circular points and isotropic line and Laguerre theorem are given firstly. Then according to the projective invariant of central projection, Laguerre theorem and the nature of the equilateral triangle, the image coordinates of vanishing points in sides of triangles and planar circular points are computed. At last an experiment of camera intrinsic parameters being determined based on the circular points is given. In this experiment, according to obtaining three different images and extract coordinates of every feature points are obtained, the image coordinates of vanishing points and circular points are obtained linearly, and camera intrinsic parameters can be determined through Choleskey decomposition. The result of this experiment shows the approach is effective.

articleTitle: User expectations of the design of a map-based mobile guide system for public arts
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Studies on map-based mobile guides are quite popular in recent years. Due to the limitations of mobile devices, the design of the functions and learning content on mobile devices are much more complicated than those on traditional e-learning systems. The aim of this paper attempts to understand the expectations of participants on the function and content design of map-based mobile guides. We conducted a questionnaire survey of students and staff of a college campus in northern Taiwan, and we got the results by using statistical methods to analyze the data.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Multiple Intelligences Theory and environment education in middle and primary school
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Redesigning the user interface of handwriting recognition system for preschool children
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Nowadays there are handwriting recognition systems that can be occupied to assist children learning how to write properly. However, one of the major barriers that hinders them using the system is its complex user interface where the designed is based on adult preferences. Therefore in this paper, we present the guideline to redesign the user interfaces via our experience developing a handwriting recognition system for pre-school children named Handwriting-based Learning Number (HLN). The redesign process has followed eight guidelines and rules as presented by Schniederman. The user interface satisfaction evaluation result done using Questionnaire for User Interface Satisfaction (QUIS) is very convincing where the users are almost satisfied with the redesign process that we did to the user interface. Hence we found that the guidelines are very useful and developers are all welcome to follow it if they intend to do similar system like us.

articleTitle: Carving surface modeling of image based on Gaussian RBF
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Carving surface modeling is directly established using the RBF interpolation algorithm according to the pixels information of the image with clear texture and relatively simple structure. This method segments the image, and analyses and computes the pixel values and their position parameters for the sub-images, and those feature parameters are used for construction of the surface patches based on quadratic linear combinations of Gaussian functions. The modeling is implemented by limited smooth connection of the retrieved Gaussian surface patches with good slickness and positive definiteness. The established surface model can represent the basic structure characteristics of the original objects in the image, and satisfy the requirements of digital carving processing. Relatively low algorithm complex and strong practicability are the features of this method.

articleTitle: The conception of Quasi-PLC and its application in industrial control system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: After investigating the conception and features of PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) and embedded system, in this paper the conception of a Quasi-PLC is proposed, which combine the advantages of PLC and embedded system. The architecture of Quasi-PLC and a Top-Down design method with collaboration design of software and hardware for Quasi-PLC embedded control system are researched then. Finally, setting the large-scale industrial valve control system as an example, the conception of Quasi-PLC and related technologies are used in industrial valve control system, and a satisfied application effect is obtained, which proves the rationality of the conception of Quasi-PLC and related technologies.

articleTitle: Low noise temperature measurement methods in radio astronomy
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Noise temperature of the receiver and low noise amplifier are become lower and lower with the fast development of electronic technique, it has become difficult to measure the noise temperature accurate and rapid. In this paper, various methods of noise temperature measurements in radio astronomy are described. The factors that influence the measurement precision also are discussed.

articleTitle: Cross-case analysis of innovative pedagogical practices using technology
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Our paper presents findings from a secondary analysis of the SITESm2 study, using tools developed to characterize educational innovative pedagogical practices using technology in terms of the level of their innovativeness as well as factors involved in the initiatives, within the schools and outside it. Findings exhibit vast variations among initiatives in terms of their level of innovativeness as well as in the domains of innovation. Also, immense differences were found in the factors involved in these educational enterprises; however, conclusions were reached regarding patterns of innovativeness, implicating that some domains are prone to innovation more than others; also that involvement of some factors is necessary for the success of these initiatives.

articleTitle: Computer application in failure analysis of carbon/epoxy composite loops
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: the paper presents a failure analysis method of carbon/epoxy composite loops with the assistance of computer. The composite loops wrapped around metal pins form a kind of mechanically-fastened joint by filament winding technique. As are well known, mechanically-fastened joints under tensile loads generally fail in three basic modes, referred to as net-tension mode, shear out mode, and bearing mode. Among them, the bearing mode is an ideal failure mode. Through the failure analysis, the main failure mode of the joint of carbon/epoxy composite loops wrapped around metal pins mainly is the bearing mode. The failure load and the failure mode of the joint were analyzed numerically and experimentally. Hashin failure criteria were used in the failure analysis. Experiments of composite loops proved that the main failure mode of loops was bearing and delamination which were coincident with the numerical analysis.

articleTitle: Network flow prediction based on grey-support vector regression technology
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In order to solve the shortcoming of BP neural network, a novel prediction method is presented to predict network flow. The combination of grey prediction model and support vector regression is applied to predict network flow in the paper. We employ collected network flow experimental data to test the performance of the combination model of grey prediction model and support vector regression. The mean relative error of grey prediction model and support vector regression is 1.94, while the mean relative error of BP neural network is 3.43. It can be seen that the combination model of grey prediction model and support vector regression is superior to BP neural network.

articleTitle: Evaluation model based on variable fuzzy sets for water resources carrying capacity in haihe river basin
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Considering the fuzzy feature in assessment, evaluation model based on variable fuzzy sets that can consider the good and bad characters of indexes is established. The method is developed to evaluate water resources carrying capacity in Haihe basin, and the results show that new evaluation methods is feasible and can effectively evaluate water resources carrying level.

articleTitle: A semantic algorithm for automatic interface generation of services participating in choreographies
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: One of the most important concerns in Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) is to identify required services and their interfaces. Service interfaces are used to search required organization services or developing them from scratch. Web Service Choreography Description Language (WS-CDL) describes the message exchanges between the collaborating participants, defining how these participants must be used together to achieve a common business goal. Choreography descriptions include key information of participant service interfaces. So, they cane be sued to generate service interfaces. In this paper, an algorithm is presented for semantic and automatic generation of service interfaces participating in choreographies. In this algorithm, similar WS-CDL elements, with the same semantic and functionality properties, are combined to achieve a more summarized and flexible choreography description. This choreography description is then used to derive available service interfaces. This algorithm aims to help developers to facilitate, automate and speedup development process of SOA-based software systems.

articleTitle: Network teaching platform for college education
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In this study, network teaching platform of college education is discussed in detail. Not only the update use of network teaching is investigated but also the problems that are encountered by network teaching are also discussed to make network teaching become effective methods in college education.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Developing a Mega event impact scale
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The design of teaching activities which based on WebQuest
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The paper takes the Bridge that is an article in the Primary Chinese textbook for example to mainly introduce the design of teaching activities based on WebQuest. It introduces the objectives, tasks and implement methods of the preparation, teaching design, website production, system integration and website publishing and use in various stages. What is more, this paper also puts forward some ideas to raise the teaching efficiency and improve the existing teaching progress.

articleTitle: Construction Three-Dimensional observation system of teacher-student interaction behavior in Classroom and Practice
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Teacher and student interaction behavior in class is multi-level and multi-angle. Classroom organization, teacher-student speech, teacher-student classroom teaching activities are the three main aspects of interaction behaviors. The aim of this paper is to study a comprehensive, detailed classroom observation research tools based on classroom organization, classroom speech, classroom activities. The main method of this paper is the classroom observation, including on-site observation and comparison with video. This paper has established a Three-Dimension Classroom Observation System based on classroom organization, classroom speech, classroom activities, including a three-dimension classroom observation log. This paper has established a three-dimensional codes classroom behavior, and the method of the codes, in order to research classroom teaching. Practice of classroom observation by one year, found that the system can be more comprehensive and detailed observation of teacher-student interaction in class. And it can improve the teaching efficiency in classroom.

articleTitle: “Analytical teaching” research and practice on computer programming course
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper proposed a method named “analytical teaching”, and completely introduced its teaching characteristics and the implementation methods. Combining computer programming courses, it put forward a specific reformation proposal about the traditional teaching models. At the same time, this paper demonstrates that “analytical teaching” has great significance in developing student's awareness of innovation, ability of innovation and spirit of innovation.

articleTitle: Implementation of an electronic emergency referral document system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The emergency department (ED) represents an important transition of care for patients, where understanding the patient health condition is critical to forming an appropriate plan of care. Because many emergency referral visits are unplanned and urgent, this information may not be conveyed in advance to ED physicians. Loss of this data can lead to costly over-testing in the ED referral, or worse, an inappropriate disposition for the patient. In this study, we follow the XDS-MS (Cross-Enterprise Sharing of Medical Summaries) profile and present methods to implement a prototype of an Emergency department system for referral documents. The system will not only retrieve the patient's critical medical information, but also generate the XML-based CDA R2 document automatically. The CDA document can be shared among different hospital emergency departments immediately. It can not only facilitate the referral process but also solve the problem of patient's health information loses and facilitate sharing across different emergency departments.

articleTitle: Teacher's role in computer-based college English teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: College English teaching reform aims at fostering the students' ability to express in English, especially listening and speaking, which brings about computer-based college English teaching model. On the basis of the characteristics and elements of the new teaching model, the paper discusses about teacher's role in computer-based college English teaching, proposing that teachers should pay much attention to every aspect of the teaching process and take the role as a designer, provider, organizer, helper, partner, researcher and educator.

articleTitle: Mobile enabling of virtual teams in school: An observational study on smart phone application in secondary education
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Some 37 years after Alan C. Kay proposed that a portable, connected device could be used to support learning that concept has come astonishingly close to today's netbooks and smart phones providing the advantages of an active medium. Considering the saturation levels attained today with mobile devices and the ability to be Internet connected, the stage has been set to integrate those devices into the classroom. An investigation was conducted to include the efficient integration of smart phones in everyday learning considering didactic, organizational, and technical concepts. Research was initiated by collecting and categorizing potential scenarios in which mobile phones could be productively used, and analyzing scenarios for virtual teams. A Q&A Game was selected with the didactical goal to enhance the students' comprehension for a complicated subject matter. 24 students from a 6th grade secondary school (11-12 years old, 50% males, 50% females) who were familiar with Internet services participated in the test which was conducted at their school. It was astonishing how fast, trouble free, and smoothly they gathered the skills to accomplish the required tasks. The students showed not only an overall enthusiasm for the devices, but also explicitly for the teaching methods. Several critical success factors for the efficient use of smart phones in classes were then enumerated. The results indicated that smart phones are an efficient way to realize virtual teams in educational environments offering a wide variety of ways to support virtual teams in learning scenarios. In this paper technical and didactical recommendations that can be used to plan smart phone supported virtual team scenarios are presented.

articleTitle: The implementation of voice and video communication based on marine F77 station simulator
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In this paper, we first put forward the importance of developing marine F77 station simulator in GMDSS teaching and training. Then we give the main methods to develop the voice and video communications based on F77 station simulator. Flash Media Server(FMS) enables one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many communication in real time between applications created in Flash CS3. With FMS and Flash CS3, we can implement voice and video communications based on F77 station simulator easily. Through this paper, we can find that Flash CS3 and Flash Media Server are ideally matched and is an effective method to develop marine F77 station simulator.

articleTitle: An efficient fractal generating system for teaching experiment
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Fractal theory has been widely applied in many fields and accepted as an optional course in many colleges. Computer visualization will greatly improve the teaching effect of fractal but often can't be fully realized for the limitation of computing conditions. This paper presents a design schema which combines data parallelism and remote invocation technology. An efficient fractal generating platform which makes good use of available hardware environment is constructed.

articleTitle: Developing information technology skills for foreign language teachers
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The modernization revolution of the way in foreign language learning is always misconstrued as purchase of hardware equipments and set-up of language laboratories with less consideration of the improvement of teachers' quality education on computer-assisted language learning. The measurement of teachers' computational skills is restricted to the ability of operating computer or other apparatus and using multimedia courseware. Indeed, computational techniques are applicable to the whole teaching process, i.e., text processing of corpus linguistics in preparation for lessons, multimedia and hypermedia manipulation in classroom teaching, automatic exercise generation, and evaluation and assessment of language output produced by students. Based on the observation from the perspective of language pedagogy and educational technology, we propose that the computational skill training for language teachers as a minimum comprises general computer education, computer-assisted learning technology, and natural language processing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Modeling the interactive effects between urbanization and higher education
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: On the R-typed sinusoidal oscillator
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The traditional sinusoidal oscillator generally consists of RC or LC circuits, i.e, the energy-stored components of capacitor or reactor are needed as the oscillating components. In this paper, we designed a new kind of sinusoidal oscillator which consists wholly of resistance components, by means of operational amplifier. This kind of oscillator is called as R-typed oscillator.

articleTitle: Comparison of involvement between traditional and technology-assisted (Wii) physical activities in early childhood education
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This study compared the differences of involvement scale between traditional and technology assisted physical activities. Seventeen (12 girls and 5 boys) 5-year-olds participated in both traditional running game (15 minutes) and Wii Fit jogging game (15 minutes). Observation was used to study the child's level of involvement. The study found that technology assisted physical activities involved participants higher than traditional activities in energy, facial expression & posture, persistence and the overall rating. This study also found that the 5-year-olds who like technology were involved more in technology assisted activities than traditional activities. This study concluded that technology-assisted tools have higher involvement level on the 5-year-olds' physical activities.

articleTitle: The design and realization of the Web-2.0 based web course management system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This article involved Web2.0 ideas into the design of web course management system, proposed design and implementation programs of Web2.0 based web course management system. The main function of this System is to carry out daily management of the web course, update course content and relevant information, thereby enhancing the value of web course.

articleTitle: Research on design of knowledge structure design and education option in college computer courses starting with social investigation and analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The paper starts with the traditional college computer education in China lagged behind social demand. Based on substantial social investigations and teaching practices, it analyzes and discusses the concrete reform methods for college computer courses system. Meanwhile, it proposed orientation of software development and goals of future computer education, expecting find concrete reform methods for current college professional computer education.

articleTitle: Intelligence analysis in early warnning air roster training
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The paper introduces a new simulation system for training early warning air roster, which uses data mining technology on the massive accumulation training information for intelligence analysis. In the system, the model of association rules are established. Using this model, the system provide ability that arrange much more reasonable training plan for each early warning air roster. Furthermore, it can support an optimized decision of how to make up the team of rosters.

articleTitle: The research and application of the length counting device based on compensation function
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: A new kind of length counting device based on compensation function is designed. It is composed of the rotary encoders, proximity switches and CPU, etc. This counting device can be used for the paper, plastic film or steel plate's roll cutting machine and rewinding machine. It can compensate for the length loss of the sheet roll caused by the roll breaking, and have more accurate counting. This paper designs and discusses its principles, and proves it in the production practice.

articleTitle: An adaptive Fuzzy Cerebellar Model Articulation Controller via Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In the paper, a Fuzzy Cerebellar Model Arithmetic Controller (FCMAC) is proposed to solve the tracking problems of a class of nonlinear systems. First, the proposed FCMAC via parameters adaptation such that it is able to approximate an ideal controller, and then a robust controller is appended to assure the system stability in the present of approximated error. Third, the redesign of the proposed FCMAC promotes the performances of the closed-loop system. Moreover, to further optimize the redesigned FCMAC, the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is utilized to optimize the parameters of the proposed FCMAC under the requirements of system stability and the defined performance index. From the computer simulation results we can find that the performances of the system are promoted under the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Web-based equipment training system with virtual reality
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: At present, most of virtual-based equipment training systems are one-man and don't meet the need of remote and distributed equipment training. Besides, there are some disadvantages in integrating the old equipment material and building animations with user interactivity. In this paper, by combining internet/intranet with virtual reality, a web-based equipment training system with virtual reality is developed. The architecture, functions and implementation of system are introduced. Moreover, it is presented how to process 3D CAD equipment data and build the XML scenario. Finally, the operation of system is described.

articleTitle: Top education across the ITC from the sector of the social economy
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: We present a functional and useful case in the province of Toledo, in a credit union: Caja Rural de Toledo and his Foundation on the cooperative education and other segments of the population and society to improve the level of Social Economy through a project based on the theories that are posted on e-learning, and the features it has to have to be useful depending on the range of training that have the interest. This theoretical presentation shows tests that have been made since the Foundation Caja Rural de Toledo and the use that is being given to E-Learning Platform itself for those groups that assist the main financial institution: Caja Rural de Toledo.

articleTitle: Low power cache architecture with security mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Embedded cryptographic devices not only suffer from traditional physical side channel attacks, but also undergo software cache-based side channel attacks recently. The attacks can easily get the user's confidential data via information leakage in caches, and don't require any special instruments. Among existing countermeasures, software solutions can defend the attacks perfectly while leading to significant performance degradation. Hardware solutions are very effective in reducing performance overhead while their structures are complex. This paper presents a novel easily implemented cache architecture which has an added small cache and adopts certain operation mechanism. Compared with traditional cache architecture, it has reduction in miss rate ranging between 20% and 50%, and has about 8.5% of reduction in power consumption, and is secure at the same time. This paper presents both theoretical analysis and experimental results. In our experiments, the MiBench suite is used to evaluate the cache performance of miss rate and energy consumption, and the security of cache is also analyzed. It also supplies the result of Synopsys Design Compiler of the RTL cache code under the 0.18μm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Design of School-based Resource total management system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Now the distance educational resources in rural primary and middle schools can't meet rural teachers' teaching needs in practice, and at the same time it is difficult to organize and manage large amount of resources for rural schools without a good resource management system. So we provided that constructing school-based resources based on distance educational resources according to rural teachers' teaching needs and developing a school-based resource total management system can solve the problems effectively. This research has designed a school-based resource total management system, including its design goals, general structure, the function of key subsystems and the technology design of realizing the system, to help rural primary and middle schools to manage, develop and share their school-based resources.

articleTitle: The development of vocal temple lot website in mandarin and Japanese
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In modern Taiwanese temples and libraries, only exist paper type temple lot. However, to digitalized the lot system is an inevitable trend in 21st century. If we can read these lots in different languages, such as, Hakka, Taiwanese, Japanese and English, then we not only can certainly obtain a total joyful feeling, but also can increase our language ability. Hence, the main purpose of this paper is to combine 100 lots of Chinese temple, Mandarin and Japanese with computer vocal system to develop a digital temple lot system. The first, we have collect 100 Mandarin papers Temple lots from Wenwu Temple, Sun-moon Lake, and transfer them into a Mandarin and a Japanese digital. Second, we based on the Mandarin paper model temple lot to set up the Japanese Pronounce System. Third, we, via 2D Flash and a computer vocal system transfer them into a computer vocal website, and present 36 hours course in general education. As a result, we can not only promote the Japanese culture education, but also introduce the system to public as a religious culture text in general education curriculum in Taiwanese colleges.

articleTitle: Robust sliding mode control for a class of uncertain hybrid linear systems with Markovian jump parameter
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The robust sliding mode control problem of a class of uncertain hybrid linear systems with Markovian jump parameter is considered. Under the assumptions of unknown upper bounds matched system uncertainties and known upper bounds mismatched system uncertainties, the sufficient conditions are proposed to guarantee the mean exponentially stability of reduced-order sliding mode system. Under the conditions of two kinds of system uncertainties, adaptive robust sliding mode control law and general robust sliding mode control law are proposed. The control methods guarantees that the trajectory of system arrives at the sliding surface in finite time interval and is kept here thereafter. It has been shown that the sliding mode control problem for the Markovian jump systems is solvable if a set of linear matrix inequalities(LMIs) have solution. Latsly a simulation is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The integration of soft skill and hard skill in learning revolution
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Study on Order-Oriented learning model for vocational education
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: the major purpose of this study is to conceptualize Order-Oriented (the O-O) learning model, and to fulfill the major purpose, we set sub purposes in research process. It is intended to optimize industry-academia cooperation better, enrich the theory connotation, carry skill persons regular for social, and impel the overall reform of vocational education.

articleTitle: The specialty of “Information Service Engineering” in BUU: Talents cultivation mode and curriculum system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Along with service based economy has been the domination all over the world, it is necessary for universities to establish a corresponding discipline and specialty on service science to train college graduates with service-related skills and knowledge to facilitate the development of service economy in China. Service Science or Service Science, Management and Engineering (SSME) is a growing multi-disciplinary research and academic effort that integrates aspects of established fields like computer science, operations research, engineering, management sciences, business strategy, social and cognitive sciences, and legal sciences. This paper briefly introduces the strategic vision on the development of specialty named “Information Service Engineering” in College of Information, Beijing Union University, including the specialty's goal and development ideas, talents cultivation mode, curriculum system, expected results, etc.

articleTitle: A Semi-Fragile Watermarking algorithm against disarranging based on fractal compression and differentials record theory
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Semi-Fragile Watermarking could provide an effective solution for both the authentication of image content and the detection of any changes in image. This article puts forward an algorithm of restorable and fragile Watermarking based on fractal compression and differentials record theory. Three components (R, G, B) of a colorful image are processed respectively by fractal compression. In view of cone cells of vision have some differences in sensitivity to color, the compressed data have been stored in B component to restore the colorful image and the R component and G component have been processed with differentials record theory for the detection of any change in image. Several binary images had been stored into B component to resist disarranging. The presentation of modification precisely approaches pixel-level with the help of the algorithm, and the results of tests have proved a good restorability of this algorithm.

articleTitle: The opportunistic scheduling wireless body area model
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The authors use opportunistic scheduling to improve the performance of wireless body area model. Previously the model of research is not much about of the model of wireless body area. The algorithm selects the best channel to transmit the data. So the throughput reaches the maximum. It increases the rate and saves the transmission time .It produces encouraging results when we apply the algorithm on the wireless body area networks with the introduction of simulation in the system setup.The effect is better than the former research result.The algorithm can also be used in other area of the wireless communication.

articleTitle: Psychological Factors on Distance Education for Undergraduates and its Reflection
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper aims to study the psychological factors on distance education (DE) for undergraduates. Over the past 9 years, a Sino-Australia joint program (approved by Ministry of Education) has been running in Zhejiang University City College, in which is combined face-to-face learning and learning via Internet. A self-designed questionnaire was employed to carry out the investigation among 115 fourth year students selected randomly from joint programs. It consists of 45 items in two parts: demographic background (12) and individual factors affecting students learning (33). Statistical analyses yield findings. This paper is an attempt to investigate personal factors and general factors on Chinese students' learning via Internet with the intent of providing information and reflection for those who are teaching in similar mode in China.

articleTitle: The index system optimization of graduation project based on reliability and validity analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Evaluating graduation project is an important part in education graduates and is now looked as an essential element for building up a university. In order to evaluate the graduation projects more objective and fair, reliability and vadility analysis are used in building up a scientific system for the first time. Taking the students majored in the same field as samples, the index system is analyzed by the method of reliability analysis, and construct validity is analyzed based on factor analysis. According to the results, suggestions are brought forward to increases the reliability in order to optimize the system, which will be helpful for colleges to create a more objective environment in evaluating graduation projects.

articleTitle: Development of a General-Purpose Online Course Platform based-on Asp.Net
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Asp.Net2.0 is one of the popular technologies for web design, and has a good performance through the integration with the Microsoft SQL Server database. The author is based on the General-Purpose,and adopts some methods including the document analysis and the interview survey to collect the three-dimensional and dynamic information about the teachers, students and administers in order to guild the system function design of the platform. Then, the author develops the General-Purpose Online Course Platform which bases on Asp.Net technology. And the platform achieves the functions what Web-based Courses platform should have such as the creation and management of online courses, student management, operations management, team learning, online Q & A and so on. So the platform can well support that teachers (not related technology-based) are very simple and easy to develop and manage their online course and students also will be more effective and efficient participation in E-learning.

articleTitle: The interaction design of Web2.0-based network course
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: As the gradual improvement of means of network courses, interactive technology has become the core of the design. In this paper, based on the ideas and technology application of Web2.0, combining the current situation of interactive design of network course, a network course interactive module based on Web2.0 has been proposed, analyzed and discussed, and obtained a better practice effect.

articleTitle: 2D fragments stitching based on contour feature
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: 2D fragments stitching based on contour feature is researched from present condition of image stitching,digitization fragments, processing of contour and fragments matching algorithm in this paper. this is to the furtherresearch for match to have to certainly draw lessons from the meaning according to many features.

articleTitle: Exploration of experimental teaching in the Access Database Application Technology Courses
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: As one of fundamental courses, Access Database Application Technology Course has been set for liberal arts students in numerous colleges and universities in China. Experimental teaching is a crucial link for it. To some extent, traditional experimental teaching mode was monotonous, which had affected the enthusiasm of students and inhibited the development of students' personality. The purpose of this paper is to propose a new mode on experimental teaching, which includes three levels: basic experiments, developing experiments and comprehensive experiments. This new mode has been proved to be more effective in our practice.

articleTitle: Development of visual circuit calculation software based on MATLAB GUI
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: MATLAB has been widely applied in circuit analysis calculation as high-powered value calculation software. Because it is inefficient to calculate by programming, and user must master MATLAB language, so the visual circuit calculation software uses object-oriented graphic technology and GUI to automatically compute and save value solution, resolution and oscillogram. Results of experiments show that this software can calculate accurately and effectively, and be easy to master, greatly improve efficiency of circuit calculation.

articleTitle: Explicitly typed static single-assignment form
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Static single-assignment form (SSA) is an important optimizing compiler intermediate representation, and is widely used in many real-world production compilers, such as GCC, LLVM, Jikes, and MLton, etc.. This paper presents the initial results of our project to apply the techniques of proof-carrying code and certifying compilation to practical highly-optimizing compilers. To be specific, this paper presents the design of an explicitly typed static single-assignment form called TSSA. This paper presents a formalization of TSSA by defining its abstract syntax, the operational semantics, and the static semantics. This paper leads to a general semantics foundation for SSA-based optimizing compilers.

articleTitle: The possibilities of an implementation national ICT competency framework for Thailand ICT master plan
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper aims to analyse four National ICT competency frameworks which have been implemented within their respective countries. Two dimensions related to competency levels and implementation coverage are discussed and compared. The new Thailand ICT master plan 2009 - 2013 was announced on August 2009. This master plan required the strategy in human resource development; however, it did not clearly define how to establish a national IT skills framework. The results of discussions and comparisons from four competency frameworks from other countries may help to identify and to possibly assist the introduction of an appropriate IT competency framework along into the Thailand ICT master 2010 in a timely manner.

Author Keywords: Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA)

articleTitle: Eduscope - a new learning system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Pakistan is a country of varied culture and people. One can find people on extreme ends of social set-ups. People who enjoy a lavish life and at the same time people who are living below the poverty line. When it comes to children, we all want them to have the best of everything, but unfortunately due to the financial imbalance in the society many under privileged children who are intelligent, bright and motivated are not able to excel due to the lack of facilities. The learning system presented in this paper is devised for children from the less privileged families, and will try to spread awareness about the use of computer and Internet. The learning system aims to provide interactive learning environment for children, develop in them self learning ability through Internet, allow them to explore things with an open mind. The learning system will try to compensate for computer & internet illiteracy in Pakistan.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of the real-time color image correction system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: When the color linear array CCD camera works, the output color image has the dislocation phenomenon which has seriously affected the human visual effect. At the same time the dislocation phenomenon has also brought great trouble to the image processing. In order to resolve this problem, a real-time collection system with the PCI interface has been developed. The system not only has the image collection function but also has the communication function. The system is so convenient that it can be easy to achieve control and data transfer. In the system, hardware circuit module is designed with the block-style thinking. The FPGA is the core of the whole hardware circuit module, responsible for data transmission, timing logic control and serial communication. Double buffer structure ensures the data transmission reliably. The PCI driver development and the PC software application are described seriously in the software module. The DMA mode and the event notification method are adopted in the driver. The RGB color correction algorithm is introduced seriously in the software application. The experiment results show that the system has met the requirement targets. It can achieve the maximum transfer rate of 40MBps when running in the DMA mode. The system is stable and real-time when it works outdoors.

articleTitle: Facilitating coordination in the collaborative learning process
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Collaboration becomes an essential competency in the current knowledge society. In this study, a collaborative learning environment was designed to facilitate students in group collaboration. Each group was suggested to create various folders to save the milestone versions of their product. Also, a progress report was developed to coordinate group members' collaboration. The results showed that a majority of the groups used the learning environment to share information, backup versions, and hence collaborate with each other. The progress report also helped them in coordination. Implications and suggestions for designing collaborative learning environments are provided.

articleTitle: Research and simulation for secure routing protocol based on Ad hoc network
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper put forward a secure Ad Hoc On-Demand Routing (SAHODSR) protocol which adapts for Ad hoc network aiming at the mobile ad hoc network(MANET) routing protocol attacks and typical routing scheme of security problems. This protocol uses serial number of destination node, list session keys of neighbor nodes between the mobile nodes and message authentication code(HMAC) based on hash function to verify the validity of routing discovery and route reply. Neighbor nodes defend against a variety of attacks through binding MAC address with it's ID. Its best performance is self-certified key system and generate new share key with non-interactive manner which brings to very little communication cost and improve the efficiency in executing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A rational discussion on deviated problems between enterprise management teaching and business community in universities
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Multiband characteristics and fractal dimension of dipole antenna with square koch curve geometry
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper presents the analysis and design of a small size, low profile, multi-band square Koch fractal dipole antenna. The proposed antenna design, analysis and characterization have been performed using the method of moments (MoM) technique. The new designed antenna has operating frequencies of 464 MHz, 1313 MHz, 4640 MHz, and 5104 MHz with acceptable bandwidth, which has useful applications in wireless communication systems, and at these frequencies the proposed antenna has reflection coefficient <; -10 dB. The radiation characteristics, VSWR, gain, and reflection coefficient of the proposed antenna are described and simulated using 4NEC2 software package.

articleTitle: Implementing problem-based learning in an online class
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper studies learning based on constructivism, PBL (problem based learning) and dialectic relations between subjects and objects, and gives explanations to the strategy of guidance on problem-based online class. By using comparative study, this paper discusses the strategies and contents of teacher's guidance in the context of online class, and practices the strategies and contents. The results demonstrate that if the strategies of guidance are appropriate, subject consciousness of students can be improved, as well as their participation in the class, so the class becomes more active. Meanwhile, the teacher for online class should be more competent in information knowledge, design and control of class than in traditional class.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Numerical simulation on the plate based on wind tunnel tests
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: On cultivating college English teachers' information literacy in China
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: To improve the national information literacy and cultivating information-based talents is a fundamental of constructing information society. And the education in teachers' information technology is a powerful strength in promoting the construction of information society. College English teachers' information literacy is of particular significance in promoting current national college English reform and the nationwide educational reform. This article focuses on the definition and concept of information literacy, and explores the ways to cultivate college English teachers' information literacy in China.

articleTitle: Research on military logistics network model based on JIT
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The building of military logistics network is an important issue for the construction of new forces. After analyzing the characteristics of the military logistics network and the application of JIT mode in military logistics network, this paper throw out the structure of our military logistics network model based on JIT. At the same time, by giving a description of logistics center layout, location, organizational network, and share-based information networks, we described the structural model and the strategy for the construction of military logistics network based on JIT.

Author Keywords: the Construction of Military Logistics Network

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Construction and practice of “Two Fundamentals” instruction model for “university physics”
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Effective strategies for “Circuit Analysis” course teaching based on cooperation and reseach
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: “Circuit Analysis” course is a major professional foundation course of electrical information majors. Analyze the traditional “Circuit Analysis” course teaching's deficiencies and problems, the course's teaching is reformed and practiced. The course's teaching is based on cooperation and research. Combining with the specific circumstances of the students, we take a number of effective strategies, such as the combining of large-class teaching and small-class group discussion based on cooperation and research, the combining of knowledge learning and engineering ability training, the reform of the assessment based on teaching methods of “cooperation and research” and so on. Through the implementation of these strategies, we improve the interaction between teaching and learning, and play the autonomy of the students learning. The teaching model of “teaching-based” is changed to the teaching model of “learning-based”. The philosophy of “student-centered, teacher-led teaching method” is firmly established. This method fully mobilizes the enthusiasm of two aspects of teaching and learning, improves teaching efficiency and teaching quality, and forms characteristics of the course.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high-bandwidth digital content protection receiver
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper focuses on design and implementation of a receiver supporting high-bandwidth digital content protection (HDCP). Besides architectural analysis and design approach discussions, a detailed micro architecture is proposed and implemented. Cipher datapath, controller, registers and I2C interface are implemented, and both place-and-route and custom design method is used. The HDCP receiver is suitable for uses as an IP embedded in digital video interface or high definition multimedia interface chips.

articleTitle: An analysis on employment chance and job requirements for automobile service engineering students
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: The rapid development of automobile industry leads to the overall prosperity of auto service industry. This provides a lot of employment opportunities for automobile service engineering graduates. Based on the employment needs survey of the automobile service Engineering, this paper carries out the auto industry chain analysis. And the requirements of basic knowledge and professional skills for the different auto jobs are discussed. This study provides a useful reference for better training of automobile service professional students.

articleTitle: A probe into the development process of enterprises e-learning courseware
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper introduces the definition, features and developing groups of E-learning firstly, probing into the general developing process, including front-end analysis, design, development, test and evaluation. And then the paper proposes a specific developing case. Finally, this paper raises some issues that shall be noticed in the developing process.

articleTitle: Sustaining the creativity of students who may lack in drawing skills with ICT tools in ideation
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: There is usually this common inevitable association of creativity to designers or artists as they are often thought of to be well-versed in their drawings and representations techniques. The teachers in the Craft and Technology (C&T) Department have gone about exploring the possibility of capturing students' creative ideas without the need to be good in drawing (representation) in the context of the subject of Design and Technology (D&T). For this paper, the teachers are interested in exploring how Information and Communication Technology (ICT) tools can help sustain the students' creativity in their ideation process.

articleTitle: Study on constraint-based texture synthesis
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Texture synthesis has been an active research topic of computer graphics,vision,and image processing ,it has been well studied in recent years. while the constraint-based texture synthesis texture is the more meaningful direction of the synthesis technologies. Constraint synthesis refers to fix a number of points or some textures around the target area and carry out texture synthesis to the target region , which is mainly applies to high precision requirements such as image inpainting, artistic style analogy and other occasions. Given in this paper is an overview of the state of the constraint-based texture synthesis and several typical approaches are described and analysed. finally, some existing problem and future work are discussed.

articleTitle: Teaching research and exploration of basic computer course for Music Majors
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: According to the specialty of computer education among Music students, this article is aimed at cultivating the Music Majors' practical application of computer. In teaching content, methods, means, and other aspects, the author will show his research and exploration he makes during the practice.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis for the effect of material properties on the punching of bimetal sheets
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Based on the isotropic elastic model , bilinear kinematic hardening model, and bilinear isotropic hardening model, finite element analysis of elastic and plastic problems for punching bimetal sheets was performed with the help of the finite element analysis software named ANSYS. The effect principles of material properties of two constituent metals on the stress and strain are also described in this paper. These principles are beneficial to the design and optimization for punching bimetal sheets and the development of bimetal sheets.

articleTitle: A finite automaton to represent structure of conjugate and single Bangla letters
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In any language the letters of that language must be detected unambiguously to form words or sentences of that language.
