articleTitle: Research on experiment teaching of “Computer Network” in local University
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: This paper has expounded the importance of “Computer Network” experiment teaching in local University, and further explains how to improve the quality of “Computer Network” experiment teaching from three perspectives, the pilot project setting, teaching process organization and evaluation of experiments. This research is of certain guidance to teaching reform in Computer Major and education proposal of personnel training in local University.

articleTitle: Research and discussion on Introduction to Computer Science and Technology teaching based on methodology
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: According to our department's reformation of Introduction to Computer Science and Technology curriculum building, introduced the teaching experience of Introduction to Computer Science and Technology teaching based on Methodology, come up with the proper content and mode of teaching for undergraduate teaching, discussed several questions in Course Teaching.

Author Keywords: Introduction to Computer Science and Technology
Methodology of Computer Science and Technology

articleTitle: A kinesthetic-based collaborative learning system for distributed algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: In this paper, we present a learning support system DASE-E to help students understand fundamental concepts of distributed algorithms in computer science. DASE-E is a collaborative learning system, in which the task of students is to devise a distributed algorithm. DASE-E offers a set of small wireless terminals with accelerometers. Each student plays the role of a process with a terminal, according to the algorithm that students devised. Each terminal enables a student to take physical actions that control the behavior of a process in the simulator. After the role playing simulation is finished, students discuss their activity played back on a screen. We implemented the system for learning distributed leader election algorithms, had a trial exercise in our research group, and we confirmed that it is effective to learn the critical part of distributed systems and algorithms.

articleTitle: Fostering E-Science Application in campus grid infrastructure based on gLite middleware
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Recently, Grid computing activities in Asia-Pacific have been drawn attention, includes in high learning education institutes in Malaysia. Many university and institute in Malaysia are started to build their campus grid infrastructure. One of the main problems that most institution faced when deploying campus grid is interconnectivity between cluster/grid sites. Thanks to EGEE gLite middleware project which break this barrier. The gLite distribution is an integrated set of components designed to enable resource sharing. The distribution model is to construct different services (‘node-types’) from these components and then ensure easy installation and configuration on the chosen platforms (currently Scientific Linux versions 4 and 5). It gives flexibity to the grid administrator on how they want to customize their cluster. We present a proposal of deploying a scalable campus grid infrastructure configuration based on gLite middleware concept, focused on typical Malaysian campus grid deployment and its challanges. The main goal of this proposal is to fostering the adoption of E-Science Application widely among Malaysian institute/university.

articleTitle: The research on intelligent navigation mechanism based on the semantic model in E-learning system
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: With the rapid development of communication technology, network technology and multimedia technology areas, Internet has become an essential part in people's study and life, and E-learning systems are drawing more and more people's attention. According to the outstanding problems that exist in the current E-learning systems such as misleading easily and poor intelligence, the paper researches on using the semantic web idea to build the core conceptual relationship model based on ontology and knowledge ontology, as well as design a smart navigation for study based on the core conceptual model to solve the outstanding problems of “Trek” and poor intelligence, and then combines with an application example to describe specific design methods and processes. The application result shows that the intelligent learning navigation has a certain effect in solving easy “Trek” and improving intelligence.

articleTitle: Packet sending the digital image with high quality and speed by getting advantage from image transformation in both spatial and frequency domain
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Usage of image has been increasing and used in many applications. Image compression plays vital role in saving storage space and saving time while sending images over network. One important point of delivering digital image is time. In this paper we concentrated on the speed of packet sending with reasonable quality. The aim of this paper is to reduce image size with reasonable quality. By getting advantage from image transformation in both scope spatial domain and frequency domain. Splitting the image into 4 block s in the case of spatial domain and applying Standard Haar wavelet transformation in the case of frequency domain was the main factor for approaching the aim of this paper which was reduce image size and increase speed of delivering digital image. After huge tests in the case of frequency domain in all subbands(LL,HL,LH,HH) we made a decision for which subband contains high information and which subband contains poor information. Depending of these factors we could send less than one-sixteenth of the size of the original image to the destination and getting the reconstructed image with the acceptable quality as a result of this paper.

articleTitle: To realize the diathetic education of mathematical education and CAI by network, mathematical experiment course
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: On the base of the clear connotation of diathesis, the mathematical education plays a very important role in diathetic education was pointed out. In order to realize the diathetic education of mathematical education, the import of computer technique is imperative under the situation in the process of math teaching, so to develop CAI by network will be good for the old impart teaching and the modern discover method teaching. To be differ from CAI' s category, mathematical experiment course is a new attempt, and is playing a very important role in the teaching process, like mathematical modeling, it attract more and more students to learn math, and it provide a good environment for realizing investigated study.

articleTitle: A logistics distribution center location method based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: Rational location of logistics distribution center can reduce costs of transportation, operation and construction. In the research on location of practical logistics distribution centers, the accurate algorithms can not used for solution in general, so the heuristic methods such as genetic algorithm should be adapted. Based on construction of logistics distribution center location model, the paper improved on simple genetic algorithm with best conserving and no-replacing residue stochastic choose strategies. The solution to material location example of logistics distribution center was also provided. The example analysis indicates that it is more effective to improve the selection operator with the combination of best conserving and no-replacing residue stochastic choose strategies.

articleTitle: Design of X-band low-noise amplifier for optimum matching between noise and power
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: High Electron Mobility Transistors (HEMT) plays a crucial role in microwave low noise receivers. Low noise HEMTs are used extensively in the ultra low noise amplifier (LNAs). Design the LNA is difficult for the radio astronomical observations, especially the realization of the simultaneous about the noise matching and the power matching, as well as the full band unconditional stability. With the Agilent Advanced Design System (ADS) simulation tools, the X-band three-stage LNA using NEC-NE3210S01 HEMTs has been designed: Noise Figure<;0.6dB; power Gain>30dB at X-band (7.8~9.4GHz), full band unconditional stability.

articleTitle: The study of KPCA active learning method based on the ROC curve
publicationTitle: 2010 2nd International Conference on Education Technology and Computer
abstract: During the course of ship machinery condition monitoring, it is universal that the number of normal condition samples is greater than the number of fault samples because the factors of test difficult or expensive testing costs. In the passive learning method to train the classifier using the all normal samples , it will not only lead to too much training time and even NP problem for some machine learning methods, but also each sample has different impacts for classifier model because noise and other factors,which would lead to the phenomenon that the classifier generalization performance degradation when the bad training samples are too many. A KPCA active learning method based on the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve is proposed in this paper. In this method, the significance of each training sample is evaluated by the KPCA method, and then a sequence comprised all training samples is obtained based on the significance. Selecting the foregoing samples compose the train sets to train the classifier and evaluate the performance based on the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve step by step. At last, when the area under the ROC curve (AUC) of the data set is biggest, the data set is selected as the optimal training sample set, which is the finally result of the KPCA active learning method based on the ROC curve. The experiment results of 1:1 Cabin model show that the method is feasible and effective.
